abhedyaṃ sarvadevānāṃ kāmagaṃ śaṅkaraṃ vinā| tripureti ca te nāma khyātiṃ loke gamiṣyati|| 43||
yadaikena ca bāṇena śivo bhetsyati te puram| tadaiva yāsyase muktiṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā|| 44||
anyatte vāñchitaṃ sarva matprasādādbhaviṣyati|
brahmovāca| dattvetthaṃ sa varāndevastatraivā'ntardadhe vibhuḥ| viṣādamagamaddeva viyogāt tripurāsuraḥ|| 45||
harṣa ca vipulaṃ lebhe varānprāpya yathepsitān| trailokyavijayaṃ kartuṃ yatate sma tato balāt|| 46||
iti śrīgaṇeśapurāṇe upāsanākhaṇḍe tripurāsuravarapradānaṃ nāmāṣṭatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 38||
āditaḥ ślokānāṃ samaṣṭyaṅkāḥ 1415+46=1461
1.039 indraparājayonāmaikona catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vyāsa uvāca| tataḥ kimakarod brahmaṃ tripuro varadarpitaḥ| tatsarvaṃ kautukaṃ mahyaṃ vaktumarhasyaśeṣataḥ|| 1||
brahmovāca| tataḥ kāśmīrapāṣāṇabhavāṃ mūrtiṃ gajānanīm| sthāpayāmāsa vidhivadbrahmaṇairmantrakauvidaiḥ|| 2||
mahāntaṃ kāñcanaṃ divyaṃ maṇimuktāvibhūṣitam| gaṇeśapuramadhye sa prāsādaṃ kṛtavān śubham|| 3||
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pūjayāmāsa taṃ vibhum| namaskārairasaṅkhyātaiḥ stutibhiḥ prārthanairapi|| 4||
kṣamāpya devadeveśamanujñāpya yayau bahiḥ| dadau dādānyanekāni brāhmaṇebhyo yathārhataḥ|| 5||
tatastadabhavatsthānaṃ baṅgāle tripurasya ha| gaṇeśapuramityevaṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvasiddhidam|| 6||
tataḥ sa tripuro daityo gajānanavaroddhataḥ| nṛlokānpālayāmāsa devānāmākrame rataḥ|| 7||
padātayasturaṅgāśca gajāśca rathinastathā| daśadigbhyo yayustaṃ tu sevārthaṃ balavattarāḥ|| 8||
rājānaḥ sevakā jātā ānukūlyena tasya ha| pratikūlā gatā mṛtyuṃ yuddhaṃ kartumanīśvarāḥ|| 9||
evamākramya bhūkhaṇḍa tato'gādamarāvatīm| tata indro devagaṇairnānāyuddha karairvṛtaḥ|| 10||
airāvatasamārūḍho yayau yuddhāya daṃśitaḥ| so'pi senāṃ tridhā cakre caturaṅgāṃ mahābalaḥ|| 11||
bhīmakāyaṃ mahādaityaṃ vajradaṃṣṭraṃ ca dānavam| dhanuryuddhe gadāyuddhe śastrayuddhe ca kovidam|| 12||
astrayuddhe mallayuddhe niṣṇātaṃ daityapuṅgavam| bhīmakāyamavocat sa nṛlokasyādhipo bhava|| 13||
kālakūṭaṃ vajradaṃṣṭraṃ jagāda tripuro balī| tribhāgayā'nayā yāhi senayā tvaṃ rasātalam|| 14||
śeṣamukhyān sarvanāgān vaśān kurū mamāyajñā| ahaṃ tribhāgayā śakramākramiṣye'khilānsurān|| 15||
bhīmakāyo vajradaṃṣṭro yatha''jñapto pratasthatuḥ| caturaṅgabalairyuktaḥ svayaṃ nandanamāyayau|| 16||
divyān vṛkṣān babhañjuste vāryamāṇāstu sainikāḥ| tatra sthitvā daityarājo dūtān śakrāya prāhiṇot|| 17||
atrānayantu taṃ śakraṃ darśanāya tvarānvitāḥ| vadantu mama vākyaṃ vā mṛtyulokaṃ vrajā'dhunā|| 18||
tatra tvāṃ pālayiṣyāmi sāmnā dehyamarāvatīm| yadi yuddhe ca te buddhistadā śīghraṃ prayāhi mām|| 19||
te gatvā śakramācakhyustripurāsuraceṣṭitam| śrutvetthaṃ vacanaṃ teṣāṃ vajrāhata ivācalaḥ|| 20||
cakampe cācalaripurvāyuneva yathā tarūḥ| cintayā vyākulībhūtaḥ kimetaditi cintayan|| 21||
krodhānalena jajvāla saṃraktākhilalocanaḥ| kurvanbhasmeva lokānāṃ śoṣayanniva vāridhīn|| 22||
uvāca dūtān gacchantu yāntu yuddhāya satvarāḥ| svayamairāvatārūḍho jagarja suraśatruhā|| 23||
tena nādena mahatā kṣobhayan bhuvanatrayam| śrutvā tadvacanaṃ te tu gatā dūtā yathāgatam|| 24||
vibudhāścāpi sannaddhā nānāśastrā'sipāṇayaḥ| bhiṇḍipālakarāḥ kecit kecicchaktyṛṣṭi pāṇayaḥ|| 25||
mudgarāsidhārāḥ keciddhanurbāṇakarāḥ pare| gadākheṭakarāḥ kecit kecittu daṇḍapāṇayaḥ|| 26||
evaṃ devagaṇairyukto vajrabhṛnniryayau bahiḥ| kṛtasvastyayano viprairnānāvāditranisvanaiḥ|| 27||
tripuro dūtavākyena jñātvā yuddhodyamantu tam| sannaddhāmakarotsenāṃ prahṛṣṭāṃ caturaṅgiṇīm|| 28||
asaṅkhyātāṃ samādāya hayārūḍho'bhiniryayau| parasparaṃ dadṛśatuste sene vīrabhūṣaṇe|| 29||
kolāhalo mahānāsīd bṛṃhitairheṣitairapi| kṣveḍitai rathaghoṣaiśca vādyaghoṣairanekadhā|| 30||
tato huṅkāramātreṇa noditāstripureṇa te| vīrā yuyudhire devaiḥ sa sammardo mahānabhūt|| 31||
nābhūta svaparabodho'pi jaghnureva parasparam| evaṃ sutumule janye mṛtāste dānavā bahu|| 32||
sumanaso'pi patitā daityaśastra prapīḍitāḥ| babhuste sainikāstatra puṣpitā iva kiṃśukāḥ|| 33||
aśayyāḥ śayitāḥ kecidaṅghrihīnāstathā'pare| kramelakā gajādhyakṣā rathāśvāśca padātinaḥ|| 34||
tataḥ palāyanaparā daityā yātā diśo daśa| siṃhaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva sahasā mṛgā jīvanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ|| 35||
tato nivārya tatsainyaṃ vṛndārakaripuḥ svayam| krodhānalamahājvālo garjanmegha ivāparaḥ|| 36||
śakrasānnidhyamagamad bhakṣayanniva rodasī| svakhaḍgenāhanattīvraṃ hastaṃ vajradharaṃ hareḥ|| 37||
vajraṃ papāta taddhastāt tadadbhutamivābhavat| tadādāyā'hanad ddaityastenaivairāvataṃ gajam|| 38||
airāvataḥ prahāreṇa palāyanaparo yayau| tato jaghāna sa harirmuṣṭinā daityapuṅgavam|| 39||
sa kṣaṇaṃ patito bhūmau tata utthāya vegavān| jaghāna muṣṭinā śakraṃ dharaṇyāṃ tamapātayat|| 40||
tata utthāya maghavā daityaṃ prāha rūṣānvitaḥ| idānīṃ mallayuddhāya sajjībhavā'sureśvara|| 41||
tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭa uvāca balagarvitaḥ| kimartha tvaṃ nijaprāṇe nirdayo'si sureśvara|| 42||
kṛmikīṭapataṅgānāṃ prāṇo'tīva priyo mataḥ| gaccha deva dharaṇyāṃ te sthānaṃ dattaṃ mayā śubham|| 43||
brahmovāca| iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā jagāda balavṛtrahā| yadyahaṃ jīvitāt tvāṃ hi mocayāmi na cedripo|| 44||
tadā'haṃ dharaṇīṃ yāmi tvadājñāvaśago'dhama| tvameva hatamūrdhā'dya dharaṇīṃ yāsyase khala|| 45||
vadatyevaṃ tu devendra dainyendro nijaghāna tam| muṣṭinā hṛdaye duṣṭastato yuddhamabhūt tayoḥ|| 46||
cāṇūrakṛṣṇayoryadvat parasparajayaiṣiṇoḥ| hṛdayaṃ hṛdayenaiva hastaṃ hastena jaghnatuḥ|| 47||
jānubhyāṃ jānunī corū tābhyāṃ tau ca nijaghnatuḥ| mastakaṃ mastakenaiva kūrparaṃ kūrpareṇa tu|| 48||
pṛṣṭhaṃ pṛṣṭhena pādābhyāṃ pādau tāvabhijaghnatuḥ| pādoṃ gṛhītvā daityo'sya bhrāmayitvā muhurmuhaḥ|| 49||
tatyāja dūrataḥ śakraṃ yathā na jñāyate kvacit| ārūroha svayaṃ taṃ tu caturdantaṃ gajeśvaram|| 50||
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve himavadgirigavharam| yayuḥ śakraṃ vicinvanto daityasantrāsatāpitāḥ|| 51||
kutra vā patito devo drakṣyāmo vā kathaṃ vibhum| evaṃ sañcintayantaste bhramanto dadṛśuśca tam|| 52||
adhomukhaṃ samāyānta devendraṃ taṃ tadaiva ha| praṇemurdevasaṅghāstamāliliṅgastathā'pare|| 53||
pūjayāmāsurapare bījayāmāsa kaścana| pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cāsya cakruḥ kecana bhaktitaḥ|| 54||
tatraiva nyavasan sarve guptarūpāḥ surāstadā| daityastvairāvatārūḍho yayau tāmamarāvatīm|| 55||
devasthānāni daityānāmindrāsanagataḥ svayam| dadau vibhajya pratyekaṃ mānapūrvaṃ suradviṣām|| 56||
divya vāditranirghoṣaiḥ śṛṇvan gāndharvanisvanān| kinnaraiḥ sevyamānastu reme cāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ|| 57||
iti śrīgaṇeśapurāṇe upāsanākhaṇḍe indraparājayonāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 39||
āditaḥ ślokānāṃ samaṣṭyaṅkāḥ 1461 + 57 = 1518
1.40 stotra nirūpaṇaṃ nāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
brahmovāca| ākramya devadhiṣṇyāni daityo'gād brahmaṇaḥ padam| parākramaṃ daityakṛtaṃ śrutvā deva mukhāt purā|| 1||
brahmā yayau nābhipadmaṃ viṣṇuḥ kṣīranidhiṃ yayau| daityasya mānasau putrau pracaṇḍaścaṇḍa eva ca|| 2||
pracaṇḍaṃ sthāpayāmāsa brahmaloke'dhināyakam| tataścaṇḍaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhe cakāra svāminaṃ svayam|| 3||
tataḥ kailāsamagamat taṃ ca daurbhyāmacālayat| bhayabhītā ca girijā''liliṅge śaṅkaraṃ bhṛśam|| 4||
tataḥ kailāsamagamad yuddhākāṅkṣī mahāsuraḥ| tena tuṣṭo mahādevo daityasya paurūṣeṇa ca|| 5||
bahiryayau varaṃ dātuṃ nijabhaktasukhapradaḥ| dadarśa tripuraṃ daityaṃ varaṃ vṛṇvityathā'bravīt|| 6||
sa vavre yadi tuṣṭo'si dehi kailāsamadya me| gaccha mandāraśikharaṃ yāvanmama manorathaḥ|| 7||
śaṅkaro'pi dadau tasme kailāsaṃ svalpakāline| svayaṃ jagāma giriśo mandārādriṃ gaṇairvṛtaḥ|| 8||
kailāsaśikharārūḍho jaharṣa tripurāsuraḥ| evaṃ devānvaśe kṛtvā punarāyād rasātalam|| 9||
bhīmakāyo'pi balavān bhūmaṇḍala gato balāt| vaśe cakāra nṛpatīn ṛṣīn sarvān babandha ca|| 10||
agnikuṇḍāni sarvāṇi devatṛptikarāṇi ca| āśramāṃśca babhañjā''śu tīrthāni ca viśeṣataḥ|| 11||
tāpasāṃsrāsayāmāsa kārāgāra samāśrayāt| svāhāsvadhāvaṣaṭkārān vedasyābhyasanāni ca|| 12||
sadācārān sadā dveṣṭi sarvagarvasamanvita| vajradaṃṣṭro'tha saptāpi pātālāni vaśe'nayat|| 13||
śeṣaṃ ca vāsukiṃ caiva takṣakaṃ sarvabhoginaḥ| nirviṣān saviṣāṃścaiva cakāra vaśavartinaḥ| vajradaṃṣṭro ratnajātaṃ bubhuje'preṣayacca tam|| 14||
nāgāṅganābhiśca kutūhalena reme sadā'sau samado'tiharṣāt| bhogān vibhuñjan vividhāni ratnānyādāya yātastripurāntike saḥ|| 15||
pātālavaśyatāṃ śaṃsan lebhe mānaṃ tato'dhikam|| 16||
vastrāṇi ca mahārhāṇi grāmān dāsānanekaśaḥ| evaṃ trilokān vaśagān kṛtvā daityo nananda ha|| 17||
devāḥ sarve guhāvāsāścintayāmāsuranvaham| kathamasya vadhaḥ kasminkāle vāpi bhaviṣyati|| 18||
kasmādveti na jānīmo labdho'nena varaṃ kutaḥ| evaṃ vyākucitteṣu sureṣu munisattama|| 19||
āyayau nāradastatra trailokyacara icchayā| dadarśaṃ dīnāndevāṃstānuttatāra nabhaḥ pathāt|| 20||
dṛṣṭvā sarve nāradaṃ tamuttasthu sahasā''darāt| āliliṅguśca nemuśca pupūjuśca yathākramam|| 21||
viśrāntaṃ paripapracchustripurasyavarādikam|
devā ūcuḥ| tripureṇa samākrāntaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācarām|| 22||
sthāthāni no gṛhītāni keśāstenāpi nirjitāḥ| śaraṇaṃ kaṃ vrajāmo'dya kathaṃ tasya vadho bhavet|| 23||
varāśca kena dattā no vadā'sya tripurasya bhoḥ|
nārada uvāca| kathayāmi samāsena daityasya ceṣṭitaṃ mahat|| 24||
divyavarṣasahasraṃ sa tatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ| prasādayāmāsa vibhuṃ gaṇeśaṃ devanāyakam|| 25||
tenā'smai durdharā dattā varāḥ sarvabhayaṅkarāḥ| devarṣipitṛbhūtebhyo yakṣarakṣa piśācataḥ|| 26||
na nāgebhyo bhayaṃ dattaṃ vinaikaṃ śaṅkaraṃ vibhum| prasādayantu deveśaṃ dviradānanamādarāt|| 27||
ārādhayantu sarve'pi vighneśaṃ sarvasiddhidam|
devā ūcuḥ| kathamārādhanaṃ tasya devadevasya dhīmataḥ|| 28||
kartavyaṃ muniśārdūla kṛpayā tadvadasva naḥ|
nārada uvāca| ahamekākṣaraṃ mantraṃ kathayāmyakhilān prati|| 29||
tena mantreṇa te sarve mayā dattena bhaktitaḥ| anuṣṭhānaṃ prakurvantu sarve'pi sthiramānasāḥ|| 30||
yāvataṃ pratyakṣatāmeti devo'sau gaṇanāyakaḥ| sa eva tadvadhopāyaṃ vadiṣyatyakhilānprati|| 31||
nānyopāyaṃ prapaśyāmi tasmāt kurvantume vacaḥ|
brahmovāca| ityuktvā nāradaḥ sarvānupadiśya manuṃ ca tam|| 32||
jagāma tatkṣaṇādeva vīṇāgānarato muniḥ| tataḥ sarve suravarā gaṇeśadhyānatatparāḥ|| 33||
ekapādasthitāḥ kecitkecitapadmāsanasthitāḥ| kecidvīrāsanayutāḥ kecinmīlitalocanā| nirāhārā jitaśvāsā jepurmantraṃ munīritam|| 34||
tato bahugate kāle karūṇābdhirgajānanaḥ| anuṣṭhānaṃ nirīkṣyaiṣāṃ devānāṃ cirakālajam|| 35||
āvirbabhūva gaṇapasteṣāmagre varapradaḥ| ullasatsvarṇamukuṭaścārūkuṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ|| 36||
dantanyastakaro rājatkaṭisūtravarāṅgadaḥ| pāśaṃ sṛṇiṃ ca paraśuṃ kamalaṃ ca bhujairdadhat|| 37||
raktacandanakastūrīsindūraśaśibhūṣaṇaḥ| vidyuttejolasatkāntiḥ koṭisūryasamaprabhaḥ|| 38||
dṛṣṭvaivaṃ sahasā devaṃ vināyakamanāmayam| tejasā dharṣitāḥ sarve bhayamāpuśca kecana|| 39||
praṇemuḥ sahasā kecid devāstaṃ dviradānanam| pūjayāmāsurapare harṣagadgadabhāṣiṇaḥ|| 40||
svasaṅkaṣṭa vināśāya tuṣṭuvu ko'pi taṃ vibhum| prasādasumukhaṃ devaṃ sumukhaṃ saṅkaṭāpaham|| 41||
devā ūcuḥ| namo namaste paramārtharūpa namo namaste'khilakāraṇāya| namo namaste'khilakāraṇāya sarvendriyāṇāmadhivāsine'pi|| 42||
namo namo bhūtamayāya te'stu namo namo bhūtakṛte sureśa| namo namaḥ sarvadhiyāṃ prabodha namo namo viśvalayodbhavāya|| 43||
namo namo viśvabhṛte'khileśa namo namaḥ kāraṇakāraṇāya| namo namo vedavidāmadṛśya namo namaḥ sarvavarapradāya|| 44||
namo namo vāgavicārabhūta namo namo vighnanivāraṇāya| namo namo'bhaktamanorathaghna namo namo bhaktamanorathajña|| 45||
namo namo'bhaktamanoratheśa namo namo viśvavidhānadakṣa| namo namo daityavināśaheto namo namaḥ saṅkaṭanāśakāya|| 46||
namo namaḥ kārūṇikottamāya namo namo jñānamayāya te'stu| namo namo'jñānavināśanāya namo namo bhaktavibhūtidāya|| 47||
namo namo'bhaktavibhūtihantre namo namo bhaktavimocanāya| namo namo'bhakta vibandhanāya namo namaste pravibhaktamūrte|| 48||
namo namastattvavibodhakāya namo namastattvaviduttamāya| namo namaste'khilakarmasākṣiṇe namo namaste guṇanāyakāya|| 49||
brahmovāca| evaṃ stuta surairdevo dviradānana īśvaraḥ| uvāca paramaprīto harṣayat surasattamān|| 50||
gaṇeśa uvāca| stotreṇa tapasā caiva surāḥ santuṣṭimāgataḥ| dadāmi sakalābhīṣṭaṃ tad vṛṇudhvaṃ sureśvarāḥ|| 51||
devā ūcuḥ| yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa tripuraṃ jahi dānavama| sarvaiṣāmadhikārān no gṛhītvā yastu tiṣṭhati|| 52||
tvayaivāsyā'bhayaṃ dattaṃ sarvāmarasamūhataḥ| ataḥ sma saṅkaṭaṃ prāptāḥ saṅkaṭānmocayā''śu naḥ|| 53||
tvāme śaraṇaṃ prāptā eṣa eva varo hi naḥ|
gaṇeśa uvāca| vārayiṣye bhayaṃ sarvaṃ tasmād ghoratarād hi vaḥ|| 54||
bhavatkṛtamidaṃ stotramatiprītikaraṃ mam| saṅkaṣṭanāśanamiti vikhyātaṃ ca bhaviṣyati|| 55||
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām| trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhedetat saṅkaṣṭaṃ nāpnuyāta kvacit|| 56||
brahmovāca| iti dattvā varaṃ teṣāṃ surāṇāṃ jagadīśvaraḥ| paśyatāṃ munidevānāṃ tatraivā'ntardadhe vibhuḥ|| 57||
iti śrīgaṇeśapurāṇe upāsanākhaṇḍe stotranirūpaṇaṃ nāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 40||
āditaḥ ślokānāṃ samaṣṭyaṅkāḥ 1518 + 57 = 1575
1.41 nāradāgamanonāma ekacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
vyāsa uvāca| varadena gaṇeśena prabhuṇā sarvakāriṇā| kiṃ kṛtaṃ tanmamācakṣva pṛcchate caturānana|| 1||
brahmovāca| tato gajānano viprarūpeṇa tripuraṃ yayau| mahārhāsanasaṃviṣṭaṃ dadarśa dvijasattamaḥ|| 2||
sa utthāya namaskṛtya svāsane copaveśayat| sampūjya paripapṛccha kuta āgamyate dvija|| 3||
kā vidyā kiṃ va te nāma pṛcchate brūhi me dvija| prayojanaṃ ca kiṃ te'sti śaktiścet karavāmahe|| 4||
dvija uvāca| sāyaṅgṛhā vayaṃ daitya sarvajñāḥ sarvavedinaḥ| icchāvihārā lokānāṃ bhramāmo hitakāmyayā|| 5||
kalādharetyeva nāmnā vikhyātā bhuvanatraye| draṣṭukāmā vaibhavaṃ te samprāptā bhavanaṃ tava|| 6||
akhilāḥ sampadaste tu dṛṣṭvā tṛptāḥ sma sāmpratam| na kailāse na vaikuṇṭhe brahmaloke'pi nendṛśī|| 7||
pade śākre na vai sampad yādṛśī dṛśyate tava|
daitya uvāca| nāmamātraṃ kalādhāraḥ kiṃ vā jānāsi tāṃ dvija|| 8||
sampadaḥ savelokeṣu yābhya etā praśaṃsasi| jānāsi ced darśaya me tāsāṃ madhye mahotkaṭām|| 9||
dṛṣṭvā dāsye vāñchitaṃ te priyaṃ prāṇānapi dvija| na smare parihāse'pi vitathaṃ bhāṣitaṃ mune|| 10||
kalādhara uvāca| pareṣāṃ sampadaṃ dṛṣṭvā kiṃ syāt tava suradviṣaḥ| vinayāt te prasanno'haṃ kalayā te dadāmi vai|| 11||
kāñcanaṃ rājataṃ lauhaṃ tripuraṃ śarasaṃsthitam| rama tatra sthiro daitya cirakālaṃ yathā sukham|| 12||
abhedyaṃ deva gandharvairmānuṣairūragairapi| kalpitārthapradaṃ tatte kāmagaṃ kāmadaṃ śubham|| 13||
yadaivaikena bāṇena kasmiścit kālaparyaye| bhetsyate tad haro daitya tadā nāśamupaiṣyati|| 14||
brahmo vāca| ityuktvā dhanurādāya saṃstabhya śaramantarā| puratrayaṃ nirmame'sau bhuvanatrayasannibham|| 15||
vicitrairbhavanai ramyairdīrghikārāma saṃyutaiḥ| nānāpakṣigaṇairjuṣṭaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ khagam|| 16||
māyayā mohito daityastatrastho cahṛṣe bhṛśam| jagarja ghanavaddaityo lokatrayavikampanaḥ|| 17||
na mattaḥ śreṣṭha ityevaṃ garvadarpasamanvitaḥ| trailokyaṃ kṣobhayāmāsa brāhmaṇaṃ tamathābravīt|| 18||
yācasva durlabhataṃra tatte dāsye dvijottama| ityuktvā sa dvijaḥ prāha taṃ daityaṃ nispṛho'pi san|| 19||
dvija uvāca| ahaṃ kailāsamagamaṃ dṛṣṭavān mūrtimuttamām| śivena pūjitāṃ samyag gāṇeśīṃ cintitārthadām|| 20||
tāmānaya tvaṃ me dehi śaktiryadyasureśvara| netādṛśī mayā mūrtistrailokyañcaratekṣitā|| 21||
ato mama manastasyāmāsaktaṃ daityasattama| tāṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyo'haṃ bhaviṣyāmyasureśvara|| 22||
kīrtiṃ te prathayiṣyāmi trailokye sacarācare| na dātā tripurācchreṣṭho vāñchitaṃ yaḥ prayacchati|| 23||
daitya uvāca| śaṅkara kiṅkaraṃ manye gaṇaye na ca devatāḥ| ānayitvā pradāsyāmi tāṃ mūrtiṃ dvijapuṅgava|| 24||
brahmovāca| ityuktvā pūjayāmāsa taṃ kalādharamādarāt| dadau tasmai daśagrāmāna govastrabhūṣaṇāni ca|| 25||
muktāphalāni bhūrīṇi mahārhāṇītarāṇi ca| ratnāni ca pravālāni rāṅkavāstaraṇāni ca|| 26||
dāsīdāsaśataṃ nānābhūṣāyuktaṃ dade'suraḥ| sadaśvān savarūthāṃśca svarṇākṣān rājatān rathān|| 27||
pragṛhyaitad balāddattaṃ prayayau sa kalādharaḥ| svāśramaṃ harṣayan patnīṃ sarvānāśramavāsinaḥ|| 28||
brahmovāca| evaṃ ca sarva vṛttāntaṃ nārado'kathayatsurān| te'pi kālaṃ pratīkṣanto divasānaticakramuḥ|| 29||
iti śrīgaṇeśapurāṇe upāsanākhaṇḍe kalādharagamanaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 41||
āditaḥ ślokānāṃ samaṣṭyaṅkāḥ 1575 +29 = 1604
1.42 yuddhavarṇanaṃ nāma dvicatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
vyāsa uvāca| kṛtavān kimu daityaḥ sa gate tāsminkalādhare| kathamānīya dattā'smai mūrtiścintāmaṇeḥ śubhā|| 1||
etatkathaya me sarva vistārya caturānana| līlā gajānanīḥ śṛṇvan na tṛpyāmi samāsataḥ|| 2||
brahmovāca| tasmingate yadakarot sa daityo munisattama| tatsarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvāvahito mune|| 3||
dūtau sampreṣayāmāsa mandarādristhitaṃ śivam| aśikṣayacchivaṃ gatvā brūtaṃ madvākyamādarāt|| 4||
mūrtiścintāmaṇeste'sti gṛhe sarvārthadā śubhā| dehi tāṃ daityarājāya sāmnaiva girijāpate|| 5||
pātāle svargaloke vā martye vā punaradbhutam| tatsarvaṃ tena daityaina hyānītaṃ svagṛhe talāt|| 6||
śīghnamānīyatāṃ deva yāvo daityaṃ mahābalam| na dāsyase yadā sāmnā tadā daityaḥ parākramī|| 7||
grahīṣyati balāttāntu tato duḥkhamavāpsyasi| iti daityavacaḥ śrutvā jagmatustauṃ śivaṃ prati|| 8||
āhatustau mahādevaṃ daityarājena śikṣitam| itthaṃ dūtavacaḥ śrutvā trinetraḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ|| 9||
uvāca dūtau dūtau vāmiti kṛtvā kṣame vacaḥ| kāmasyeva bhaved bhasma no cedvāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ|| 10||
kiṃ kāryaṃ tena daityena tṛṇībhūtena me vibhoḥ| āyātu yuddhamevāstu martukāmo mamāntikam|| 11||
neyaṃ mūrtistena śakyā prāptuṃ janmaśatairapi| pralayāgniḥ pataṅgena kiṃ śāntimadhigacchati|| 12||
meroḥ pāto mūṣakena śakyaḥ kartuṃ kimojasā| asaṅkhya jala niṣkāśācchuṣkaḥ syātkiṃ mahodadhiḥ|| 13||
brahmovāca| śrutvā tu śāṅkarīṃ vāṇīṃ daityo yātauyathāgatam| abrūtāṃ svāminaṃ vākyaṃ śambhunā yadudīritam|| 14||
tadākarṇya prajajjvāla daityo vākyārthakovidaḥ| krodhānalena dīpto'sau trailokyaṃ pradahanniva|| 15||
ājñāpayacca yuddhāya svasenāṃ caturaṅgiṇīm| nirgatā sahasā senā mandarācalasammukhā|| 16||
bhūtalaṃ chādayāmāsa nirmaryādo yathā'mbudhiḥ| anekasūryasaṅkāśā vikośaiḥ śastrasañcayaiḥ|| 17||
garjantī ghanavad ghoraṃ mṛtyormānasakampinī| daityastripuramārūhya vimānasadṛśaṃ mahat|| 18||
manovegaṃ tataḥ paścājjighāṃsuḥ śambhumāyayau| bṛhanmaṇimayaṃ cārūkavacaṃ kuṇḍale'ṅgade|| 19||
muktāmālāṃ mudrikāśca kaṭisūtraṃ ca kāñcanam| mukuṇṭa ratnakhacitaṃ mahārghaṃ bibhradullasat|| 20||
yasya śabdena mahatā cakampe haramānasam| taddhanuḥ sa niṣaṅgaṃ ca kaurmaṃ kheṭamasiṃ dṛḍham|| 21||
śuśubhe śaktikā divyā'vahad yāṃ daityapuṅgavaḥ| gāyamānā nartamānā gandharvāmpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ|| 22||
bandinaścāraṇāścāpi yayurasyāgrato mudā| śaṅkaro dūtavākyena śrutvā daityaṃ samāgatam|| 23||
asaṅkhyabalasaṃyuktaṃ yuyutsuṃ kālakarṣitam| śūlapāṇirapi tadā sampūjya dviradānanam|| 24||
praṇamya taṃ parikramya puraskṛtya balaṃ balāt| āyayau krodhadīptākṣaḥ svasthalād raṇamaṇḍalam|| 25||
te vīrā vīraśabdena nādayanto diśo daśa| abhijagmuḥ praharaṇaiḥ parasparavadhepsavaḥ|| 26||
abhūtāṃ mīlite sene rajastimirasaṅkule| svaparajñānarahite jaghnatū raṇamūrdhani|| 27||
abhavattumulaṃ yuddhaṃ na prājñāyata kiñcana| gajāśvarathavīrāṇāṃ hatānāṃ śoṇitokṣite|| 28||
śānte rajasyayudhyanta vīrā vīraiḥ pṛthak pṛthak| kecit prāsaiḥ ke'pi khaḍgaiḥ kecidbāṇaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ|| 29||
ṛṣṭibhirmuṣṭibhiḥ kecit kecit paraśutomaraiḥ| hatānāṃ tatra vīrāṇāṃ hayānāṃ ca padātinām|| 30||
asṛṅnadī samabhavat keśaśaivala vāhinī| kheṭakūrmā khaḍgamatsyā śiraḥ kamalakṣūṣaṇā|| 31||
chatrāvartā ghoratarā kabandhavṛkṣavāhinī| vīrasantoṣajananī gṛddhagomāyuharṣakṛt|| 32||
dṛṣṭatvā nadīṃ tu giriśo yayau daityāntikaṃ balī| daityo'pi tripurārūḍho yayau tasya puraḥ puraḥ|| 33||
nāyako saṅgatau dṛṣṭvā dvandvaśo'nye parasparam| avyākule yuyudhire daiteyāḥ śāmbhavāstadā|| 34||
nānā praharaṇairdivyaiḥ śatrairastrairdrumairapi| teṣāṃ yuddhāni nāmāni kathayiṣye samāsataḥ|| 35||
iti śrīgaṇeśapurāṇe upāsanākhaṇḍe yuddhavarṇanaṃ nāma dvicatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 42||
āditaḥ ślokānāṃ samaṣṭyaṅkāḥ 1604 + 35 = 1639
1.43 tricatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
brahmovāca| ayudhyetāṃ dvandvaśo'tha giriśāsura nāyakau| ṣaṇmukhena pracaṇḍaśca nandinā caṇḍa eva ca|| 1||
yuyudhe puṣpadanto'pi bhīmakāyena vīryavān| bhṛśuṇḍī kālakūṭena viṣavatprāṇahāriṇā|| 2||
ayudhyetāṃ vīrabhadravajradaṃṣṭrau mahābalau| indro'pi yuyudhe tatra daityāmātyena vīryavān|| 3||
daityaputreṇa balinā jayanto yuddhadurmadaḥ| kāvyena yuyudhe tatra surācāryo'stravittamaḥ|| 4||
devānāṃ caiva daityānāmevaṃ dvandvānyanekaśaḥ| varṇituṃ naiva śakyāni mayā varṣaṃ śatairapi|| 5||
rathino rathibhiḥ sārdhaṃ gajinau gajibhiḥ saha| aśvārohāḥ svasadṛśaiḥ padātāśca padātibhiḥ|| 6||
yuyudhaḥ saṃyuge ghore nānāvādya ninādite| heṣitairbṛhitaiḥ kṣveḍairneminādaiśca śabdite|| 7||
kecicca mallayuddhena yuyudhurvividhena tu| jaghnuraṅgāni cāṅgeṣu tyaktvā śastrāṇi saṃyuge|| 8||
tataḥ pracaṇḍo navabhistāḍayāmāsa ṣaṇmukham| ākarṇākarṣanisṛtairdṛḍhairbāṇaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ|| 9||
aprāptāneva tāṃśchittvā śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ| kārtikeyaḥ pañcabhistu tāḍayāmāsa sāyakaiḥ|| 10||
sammūrchito'patadbhūmau pracaṇḍo bhrāntamānasaḥ| nandinā'pi hataścaṇḍa pañcabhirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ|| 11||
mūrchāmavāpa sahasā patito dharaṇītale| bhīmakāyaḥ puṣpadantamavidhyaddśabhiḥśaraiḥ|| 12||
chedayāmāsa samare svaśarairniśitaiḥ sa tān| tribhirevāhanat ca so'pi bhūtalamāśritaḥ|| 13||
kālakūṭaṃ bhṛśuṇḍīstu pātayāmāsa pañcabhiḥ| śarairmahābalastatra vīrabhadrau rūṣā yutaḥ|| 14||
vajradaṃṣṭra tato jaghne caturbhirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ| tānnivārya svayaṃ jaghne vīrabhadraṃ tribhiḥ śaraiḥ|| 15||
tānāpatata evāśu vīrabhadro'cchinat tribhiḥ| pātayāmāsa vegena vajradaṃṣṭraṃ tribhiḥśaraiḥ|| 16||
indro'pi vajrapātena daityāmātyaṃ nyapātayat| udyamya niśitaṃ khaḍgaṃ daityaputraḥ samāyayau|| 17||
hantukāmo jayantaṃ taṃ vīreṣu patiteṣu ca| taṃ nirīkṣya tathā yāntaṃ khaḍgaṃ ciccheda patriṇā|| 18||
jayanto'bhyahanacchīghraṃ daityasūnuṃ tribhiḥ śaraiḥ| tairāhato vaman raktaṃ nyapatan mohasaṃyutaḥ|| 19||
evaṃ sarveṣu sainyeṣu prabhagneṣu samantataḥ| dṛṣṭvā palāyanaparān daityān devagaṇārditān|| 20||
adhāvan pṛṣṭhataḥ kecit pramathā jayaśālinaḥ| evaṃ jayatsu deveṣu svasainye vidrute'pi ca|| 21||
āyayau svayameveśaṃ tripurādhiṣṭhito'suraḥ| śastrayuddhaṃ purā kṛtvā yudhyetāmasrato hyubhau|| 22||
vārūṇāstraṃ jahau daityo vṛṣṭirghoratarā'bhavat| nīhārabahule yuddhena prājñāyata kiñcana|| 23||
kvacid vidyutprakāśena svaparajñānakāriṇā| yuddhamāsīt tu tumulaṅghorarūpaṃ durāsadam|| 24||
vilokya sainyaṃ tatsarvaṃ vṛṣṭivātaprapīḍitam| śilāpātabhayāt yāte svasainye tu diśodaśa|| 25||
vāyavyamastraṃ giriśo mocayāmāsa satvaram| mahāvātānmahāmeghā viśīrṇāḥ khaṇḍaśo'mbare|| 26||
vātena ghūrṇitā senā daityānāṃ sarvato diśam| jagaluḥ pakṣipicchāni vīroṣṇīṣāṇi dūrataḥ|| 27||
patitāścūrṇitāḥ kecid rathāśvagajapattayaḥ| unmūlitā latā vṛkṣāśchādayanti sma sainikān|| 28||
pannagāstreṇa taṃ vāyuṃ tathā daityo nyavārayat| ākarṇa dhanurākṛṣya tṛṇādbāṇaṃ pragṛhya ca|| 29||
mantrayannanalāstreṇa śivasainye nyapātayat| aṅgāravṛṣṭiḥ sahasā patitā sarvadāhinī|| 30||
pralayaṃ menire sarve jvālā mālābhirarditāḥ| jvālābhyo dīpyamānābhyo mahābhītikaraḥ pumān|| 31||
āvirāsīn mahākāyo likhan mūrdhā nabhastalam| daṃṣṭrākarālavadano mahārāvaḥ kṣudhāturaḥ|| 32||
lālayan rasanāṃ ghorāṃ śatayojanavistṛtām| nāsāpavanavegena bhrāmayan kuñjarān raṇe|| 33||
bhakṣayāmāsa tāṃ senāmuragāmiva pakṣirāṭ| apīpalad bhargasenā tena puṃsā prapīḍitā|| 34||
śivapṛṣṭhaṃ samāsādya rakṣa rakṣeti cābravīt| mābhaiṣṭetyabhayaṃ tasyai dattvā vahniṃ nyavārayat|| 35||
parjanyāstraprapātena tatkṣaṇādgirijāpatiḥ| bāṇenaikena taṃ ghoraṃ purūṣaṃ sa nyapātayat|| 36||
tata utthāya puruṣo babhakṣa śivasainikān| yayuḥ palāyanaparāḥ pramathā bhayavivhalāḥ|| 37||
skhalanto nipatantaśca niśvasantaśca kampire| śivo'pi niḥsahāyatvād darīmevānyapadyata|| 38||
ṣaḍānanādayo vīrā anusatasrustameva hi| jighṛkṣurgirijāṃ daityo vicintyaikākinīṃ girau|| 39||
vihāya raṇabhūmiṃ tu yayau kailāsameva saḥ| dūrād dṛṣṭvā tamāyāntaṃ cakampe girijā tadā|| 40||
uvāca pitaraṃ gatvā daityo māṃ kiṃ nu neṣyati| tasyā dvacanaṃ śrutvā nītvā tāṃ durgamāṃ gṛhām|| 41||
avijñātāṃ svetareṇa sthāpayāmāsa nirbhayām| so'pi daityastato haimaṃ giriṃ tadgrahaṇecchayā|| 42||
āgato na dadarśātha girijāṃ kvāpi sattama| bhraman dadarśa tatraikāṃ mūrti cintāmaṇeḥ śubhām|| 43||
sahasrasūryasaṅkāśāṃ nānālaṅkāraśobhinīm| trailokyasundarāṃ sadyo gṛhītvā svasthalaṃ yayau|| 44||
nānāvāditranirghoṣaiḥ stuvadbhirvandibhirvṛtaḥ| tataḥ pātālamagamat sarvatra vijayī balī|| 45||
gacchatastasya daityasya haste'pyantarhitā tadā| mūrtiścintāmaṇeḥ sā tu tadadbhutamivābhavat|| 46||
tamevāśakunaṃ matvā tatpuraṃ punarāviśat| atyantaṃ vimanāścintāṃ durutāṃ samupāgataḥ|| 47||
iti śrīgaṇeśapurāṇe upāsanākhaṇḍe tricatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 43||
āditaḥ ślokānāṃ samaṣṭyaṅkāḥ 1639 47 = 1686
1.44 tapovarṇanaṃ nāma catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vyāsa uvāca| tataḥ kimakarocchambhuḥ tripureṇa parājitaḥ| kathaṃ tamajayaddaityaṃ tripuraṃ jayaśālinam|| 1||
brahmovāca| tataḥ śambhuḥ parāṃ cintāmāpede manasā sa kṛt| svāhāsvadhāvihīnaṃ tu bhūtalaṃ paricintayan|| 2||
kadā svasthānagā devā bhaviṣyanti gatajvarāḥ| kenopāyena vāsaḥsyāddurjayasya parājayaḥ|| 3||
evaṃ cintāture tasmin nārado munisattamaḥ| āyayo śaṅkaraṃ dṛṣṭaṃ devān sarvān yadṛcchayā|| 4||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā jahṛṣe devo martyaḥ prāpya yathā'mṛtam| pūjayāmāsa vidhivat kṛtāsanaparigraham|| 5||
āliṅgya tamuvācetthaṃ śivaścintāturo bhṛśam| devānāṃ hitamanvicchan daityasya vadhameva ca|| 6||
śiva uvāca| daityena sarvadevānāṃ kadanaṃ kṛtamojasā| tadraṇe bhagnasaṅkalpāḥ sarve devāḥ palāyitāḥ|| 7||
yātā daśa diśo brahman kaḥ kutrāste na vedmyaham| mamāpyatrāṇi tenāstraiḥ prabhagnāni sahasraśaḥ|| 8||
brahmovāca| śrutvā śivavacaḥ so'mumavādīn munisattama| manvānaḥ paramāścaryaṃ trailokyeśaparābhavam|| 9||
nārada uvāca| sarvajñe sarvavidyeśe sarveśe sarvakartari| sarvānane sarvahare sarvasyāpi niyantari|| 10||
śakte kartumakartuṃ vā'nyathākartumapi prabho| aṇimādiguṇopete ṣaḍaiśvaryavilāsini|| 11||
kiṃ vaktavyaṃ mayā deva sarvavaktṛvare tvayi| muninā gānasaktena trilokīṃ bhramatā'niśam|| 12||
tava vākyānurodhena vicārya prabravīmyaham| evamuktvā kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā punaḥ prāha śivaṃ muniḥ|| 13||
muniruvāca| yuddhāya gantukāmena nārcito gaṇapastvayā| ataḥ parābhavaṃ prāpto vanhinetraḥ pinākadhṛk|| 14||
idānīmarcaya purā vighneśaṃ vighnavāraṇam| prasādya tadvaraṃ labdhvā yāhi yuddhāya sādaram|| 15||
parājeṣyasi taṃ daityaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā|
brahmovāca| tenāpi tapasā devo mahatārādhitaḥ purā|| 16||
tena tasmai varo datto'khilavighnaughahāriṇā| maheśvaraṃ vinā mṛtyurna kenāpi bhavettava|| 17||
muniruvāca| tasmādgiriśa tasyedaṃ kāmagaṃ tu puratrayam| ekeṣuṇā dārayasva jayopāyo'yamīritaḥ|| 18||
praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe śrutvopāyaṃ muneḥ śivaḥ| śrutvā gajānanagiraṃ pūrvāktāṃ prāha taṃ munim|| 19||
śiva uvāca| satyamuktaṃ tvayā brahmaṃ tvadvākyena smṛtaṃ mayā| upadiṣṭau pūrvameva mantrau tena mune mama|| 20||
ṣaḍakṣaraikākṣarau tau sarvasaṅkaṭahārakau| yuddhevyāsaktacittena na japtau na ca saṃsmṛtau|| 21||
sarvavighnaharo devo na smṛto hi gajānanaḥ| sarveṣāṃ kāraṇaṃ kartā pātā hartā vināyakaḥ|| 22||
munirūvāca| taṃ toṣaya mahādeva mahādevaṃ gajānanam|
brahmovāca| visṛjyaṃ nāradaṃ devo jagāma tapase śivaḥ|| 23||
daṇḍakāraṇyadeśe tu padmāsanasthito'japat| praṇidhāya balāt khāni niyamya dhyānatatparaḥ|| 24||
so'tapattapa ugraṃ tu śatavarṣāṇi śaṅkaraḥ| tatastasya mukhāmbhojān nirgatastu pumān paraḥ|| 25||
pañcavaktro daśabhujo lalāṭenduḥ śaśiprabhaḥ| muṇḍamālaḥ sarpabhūṣo mukuṭāṅgadabhūṣaṇaḥ|| 26||
agnyarkaśaśino bhābhistiraskurvandaśāyudhaḥ| tadbhāsā dharṣito devo'paśyadugraṃ puraḥsthitam|| 27||
vināyakaṃ pañcamukhaṃ pañcāsyamaparaṃ śivam| taṃ dṛṣṭvā'tarkayaddevaḥ kimahaṃ dvividho'bhavam|| 28||
kiṃvā mamaiva rūpeṇa tripuro'yamihāgataḥ| trayastriṃśatkoṭideveṣvaparaḥ pañcavaktravān|| 29||
athavā svapna evāyaṃ dṛṣṭo dīrghataro mayā| athavā me varaṃ dātumāgato'yaṃ gajānanaḥ|| 30||
sarvavighnaharaṃ devaṃ yaṃ dhyāyāmi divāniśam|
brahmovāca| evamākarṇya tadvākyaṃ uvāca dviradānanaḥ|| 31||
antaryastarkito devaḥ so'yaṃ vighnaharo vibhuḥ| na me svarūpaṃ jānanti devarṣicaturāranāḥ|| 32||
na vedāḥ sopaniṣadaḥ kutaḥ ṣaṭśāstravedinaḥ| aśeṣabhuvanasyāhaṃ kartā pātā'pahārakaḥ|| 33||
brahmādisthāvaracaratriguṇānāmahaṃ prabhuḥ| tapasā'nena tuṣṭo'haṃ varaṃ dātumihāgataḥ|| 34||
varānvṛṇu mahādeva yāvato matta icchasi|| 35||
iti śrīgaṇeśapurāṇe upāsanākhaṇḍe tapovarṇanaṃ nāma catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 44||
āditaḥ ślokānāṃ samaṣṭyaṅkāḥ 1686 + 35 = 1721
1.45 śivasya varadānaṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
muniruvāca| tataḥ prasanne vighneśe deveśe vighnahāriṇi| varān ditsati śarvāya kiṃ kiṃ vavre sadāśivaḥ|| 1||
brahmovāca| gaṇeśavacanaṃ śrutvā śivovākyamathā'bravīt| smṛtvā gajānanaṃ taṃ tu svasvarūpaṃ varapradam|| 2||
śiva uvāca| daśāpi netrāṇi mamādya dhanyānyatho bhujāḥ pūjanatastavādya| tavānateḥ pañca śirāṃsi dhanyānyathastuteḥ pañcamukhāni deva|| 3||
pṛthvī jalaṃ vāyuratho diśaśca tejaśca kālaḥ kalanātmako'pi| nabho raso rūpamathāpi gandhaḥ sparśaśca śabdo mana indriyāṇi|| 4||
gandharvayakṣāḥ pitaro manuṣyā devarṣayo devagaṇāśca sarve| brahmendrarudrā vasavo'tha sādhyāḥ tvattaḥ prasūtāḥ sa carācaraśca|| 5||
sṛjasyado viśvamananyabuddhe rajoguṇātpāsi samastametat| tamoguṇātsaṃharase guṇeśa nityo nirīho'khilakarmasākṣī|| 6||
brahmovāca| tato'hamabruvaṃ devaṃ gaṇeśaṃ taṃ śivājñayā| nāma cākaravaṃ tasya yattacchṛṇu mahāmate|| 7||
tvannāma bījaṃ prathamaṃ mātṛkāṇāmoṅkārarūpaṃ śrutimūlabhūtam| yato gaṇānāṃ tvamasīha īśo gaṇeśa ityeva tavāstu nāma|| 8||
omityathokte gaṇanāyakena tutoṣa śarvaḥ pradadau varāṃśca| yaḥ sarva kāryeṣu taveśa kuryāt smṛtiṃ tadantaṃ sa labhedavighnam|| 9||
vinā smṛtiṃ tena labhecca ko'pi vāñchāryasiddhiṃ kṛmikīṭako'pi| śaivestvadīyairatha vaiṣṇavaiśca śāktaiśca saureratha sarvakārye|| 10||
śubhāśubhe vaidikalaukike vā tvamarcanīyaḥ prathamaṃ prayatnāt| yanmaṅgalaṃ sarvajaneṣu deva sayakṣavidyādharapannageṣu|| 11||
tasyeśvaro maṅgalamūrttitāṃ tvaṃ tato yato maṅgala kṛt svabhakte| ahaṃ purā'narcayatastaveśa tvayyasmṛterdaityavarasya yuddhe|| 12||
avandanāccāpa parābhavaṃ taṃ tatastavāṅghriṃ śaraṇaṃ prapannaḥ| kṣamāparādhaṃ mama sarvaśakte jayaṃ prayacchākhilajanyakāle|| 13||
ye sarvathā tvāṃ na bhajanti deva jaḍā daridrāḥ prabhavantu te'pi| bhajati te bhaktiyutā manuṣyāḥ prāpsyanti siddhiṃ nikhilārthadātrīm|| 14||
ka uvāca| itthaṃ niśamyākhilavākyasāravettā'vadadvākyamidaṃ girīśam| yadāyadā me smaraṇaṃ vidadhyāstadā'ntikaṃ te'hamiyāmumeśa|| 15||
mannāmabījena nimantrayaikaṃ bāṇaṃ tu tenaiva puratrayaṃ tat| nipātayāsmanmahasā maheśa kṛtvā sa daityaṃ khalu bhasmasāt tvam|| 16||
tataḥ svanāmnāmavadat sahasraṃ gaṇādhipo'smai praṇatāya samyak| śivāya bhaktyā parituṣṭacitto jayapradaṃ kāmakaraṃ janānām|| 17||
uvāca cainaṃ raṇakāla etat paṭhasva daityānvinihaṃsi śīghram| trisandhyametasya japānnarāṇāṃ sidhyanti kāmāḥ sakalā abhīṣṭāḥ|| 18||
śrutvā tu vākyaṃ dviradānanasya taṃ pūjya samyak śiva ujjaharṣa| saṃsthāpayāmāsa mahāgaṇeśaṃ prāsādamuccairdṛḍhamāśu cakre|| 19||
santarpya devān munisiddha saṅghān dānāni datvā dvijapuṅgavebhyaḥ| punaśca sampūjya namaścakāra devaṃ girīśo varadaṃ gaṇeśam|| 20||
uvāca sarvān maṇipūrariyaṃ tu vikhyātimāgacchatu sarvaloke| devena sarvaiśca tathoditaistairantardadhuste gaṇanātha mukhyāḥ|| 21||
antarhite munigaṇe sasure gaṇeśe śarvo'pyagāt svanilayaṃ svagaṇairūpetaḥ| gandharva yakṣa nivahairamarāṅganābhirvṛttaṃ nijaṃ paramudā girijāmuvāca|| 22||
śrutvā tadā'mṛtavacaḥ sakalaṃ girīśād deveśvarā mumudire munayaḥ sadārāḥ| yogīśvarāśca nihataṃ tripuraṃ svadhiṣṇyamamaṃsatāpyadhigataṃ giriśaprasādāt|| 23||
iti śrīgaṇeśapurāṇe upāsanākhaṇḍe śivasya varadānaṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 45||
āditaḥ ślokānāṃ samaṣṭyaṅkāḥ 1721 + 23 = 1744 1.46 śrīmadgaṇeśadivyasahasranāmāmṛtastotrakathanannāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vyāsa uvāca| kathaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ tad gaṇeśa upadiṣṭavān| śivāyaitanmamācakṣva lokānugraha tatpara|| 1||
brahmovāca| devaḥ evaṃ purārātiḥ puratrayajayodyame| anarcanādgaṇeśasya jāto vighnākulaḥ kila|| 2||
manasā sa vinirdhārya tatastadvighnakāraṇam| mahāgaṇapatiṃ bhaktyā samabhyarcya yathāvidhī|| 3||
vighnapraśamanopāyamapṛcchadaparājitaḥ| santuṣṭaḥ pūjayā śambhormahāgaṇapatiḥ svayam|| 4||
sarvavighnaikaharaṇaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam| tatastamai svakaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasramidamabravīt|| 5||
asya śrīmadgaṇeśadivyasahasranāmāmṛtastrotramālāmahāmantrasya gaṇeśaṛṣiḥ| śrīmahāgaṇapatirdevatā| śrīsvānandeśo brahmaṇaspatirdevatā| nānāvidhānicchandāsi| gamiti bījam| tuṇḍamitī śaktiḥ| svāhāśaktiriti kīlakam| sakalavighnavināśanadvārā śrībrahmaṇaspatiprītyarthe (mahāgaṇapatiprītyarthaṃ) jape viniyogaḥ|
atha nyāsāḥ| gaṇeśvaro gaṇakrīḍa ityaṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ| kumāragururīśāneti tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ| brahmāṇḍakumbhaścidvyometi madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ| raktoraktāmbaradhara ityanāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ| sarvasadgurusaṃsevya itikaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ| luptavighnaḥ subhaktāmiti karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ|
atha hṛdayādinyāsāḥ| chandaścchandovapuriti hṛdayāya namaḥ| niṣkalo nirmala iti śirase svāhā| sṛṣṭisthitilayakrīḍa iti śikhāyai vaṣaṭ| jñānaṃ vijñānamānandaṃ iti kavacāya hum| aṣṭāṅgayogaphalabhṛditi netratrayāya vauṣaṭ| anantaśaktasahita ityastrāya phaṭ| iti digbandhaḥ|
atha dhyānam| raktāmbhodhisthapotollasadarūṇasarojādhiruḍhaṃ trinetram pāśaṃ caivāṅkuśākhyaṃ paraśumabhayadaṃ bāhubhirdhārayantam| śaktyā yuktaṃ gajāsyaṃ pṛthutarajaṭharaṃ siddhibuddhīsametaṃ raktaṃ candrārdhamauliṃ sakalabhayaharaṃ vighnarājaṃ namāmi||
śrīsiddhibuddhisahitāya salakṣalābhāya śrīsvānandeśāya brahmaṇaspataye sāṅgāya saparivārāya saśaktikāya sāyudhāya savāhanāya sāvaraṇāya namaḥ| iti nāmamantreṇa mānasaḥ pañcopacāraiḥ sampūjya paṭhet|
śrīmahāgaṇapatirūvāca| asya śrīmahāgaṇapatidivyasahasranāmastotramālāmahāmantrasya gaṇeśaṛṣiḥ|| mahāgaṇapatirdevatā|| nānāvidhānicchandāṃsi||
gaṃ iti bījam|| tuṇḍaṃ iti śaktiḥ|| svāhā kīlakam||
sakalavighnavināśanadvārā śrīmahāgaṇapatiprītyarthe jape viniyogaḥ|
śrīmahāgaṇapatirūvāca| oṃ gaṇeśvaro gaṇakrīḍo gaṇanātho gaṇādhipaḥ| ekadaṃṣṭro vakratuṇḍo gajavaktro mahodaraḥ|| 6||
lambodaro dhamravarṇo vikaṭo vighnanāyakaḥ| sumukho durmukho buddho vighnarājo gajānanaḥ|| 7||
bhīmaḥ pramoda āmodaḥ surānando mahotkaṭaḥ| herambaḥ śambaraḥ śambhurlambakarṇo mahābalaḥ|| 8||
nandano'lampaṭo'bhīruḥ meghanādo gaṇañjayaḥ| vināyako virūpākṣo dhīraśūro varapradaḥ|| 9||
mahāgaṇapatirbuddhipriyaḥ kṣipraprasādanaḥ| rudrapriyo gaṇādhyakṣa umāputro'ghanāśanaḥ|| 10||
kumāra gururīśāna putro mūṣakavāhanaḥ| siddhi priyaḥ siddhipatiḥ siddhiḥ siddhivināyakaḥ|| 11||
avighnastumbaruḥ siṃhavāhano mohinīpriyaḥ| kaṭaṅkaṭo rājaputraḥ śākalaḥ sammito'mitaḥ|| 12||
kūṣmāṇḍasāmasambhūtirdurjayo dhūrjayo jayaḥ| bhūpatirbhuvanapatirbhūtānāṃ patiravyayaḥ|| 13||
viśvakartā viśvamukho viśvarupo nidhirghṛṇiḥ| kaviḥ kavīnāmṛṣabho brahmaṇyo brahmaṇaspatiḥ|| 14||
jyeṣṭharājo nidhipatirnidhipriyapatipriyaḥ| hiraṇmayapurāntasthaḥ sūyamaṇḍalamadhyagaḥ|| 15||
karāhatidhvastasindhusalilaḥ pūṣadantabhit| umāṅkakelikutukī muktidaḥ kulapālanaḥ|| 16||
kirīṭī kuṇḍalīhārī vanamālī manomayaḥ| vaimukhyahatadaityaśrīḥ pādāhatijitakṣitiḥ|| 17||
sadyojātaḥsvarṇamuñjamekhalī durnimittahṛt| duḥsvapnaprahṛt prasahano guṇīnādapratiṣṭhitaḥ|| 18||
surūpaḥ sarvanetrādhivāso vīrāsanāśrayaḥ| pītāmbaraḥ khaṇḍaradaḥ khaṇḍendukṛtaśekharaḥ|| 19||
citrāṅkaśyāmadaśano bhālacandro caturbhujaḥ| yogādhipastārakasthaḥ puruṣo gajakarṇakaḥ|| 20||
gaṇādhirājo vijayasthiro gajapatirdhvajī| devadevaḥ smaraprāṇo dīpako vāyukīlakaḥ|| 21||
vipaścidvaradonādonnādabhinna balāhakaḥ| varāharadano mṛtyujayo vyāghrājināmbaraḥ|| 22||
icchāśaktidharo devatrātā daityavimardanaḥ| śambhuvaktrodbhavaḥ śambhukopahā śambhuhāsyabhūḥ|| 23||
śambhutejāḥ śivāśokahārī gaurīsukhāvahaḥ| umāṅgamalajo gaurītejobhūḥ svardhunībhavaḥ|| 24||
yajñakāyo mahānādo girivarṣmā śubhānanaḥ| sarvātmā sarvadevātmā brahmamūrddhā kakupśrutiḥ|| 25||
brahmāṇḍakumbhaśvidvyomabhālaḥ satyaśiroruhaḥ| jagajjanmalayonmeṣanimeṣo'gnyarka somadṛk|| 26||
girīndraikarado dharmodharmoṣṭhaḥ sāmabṛṃhitaḥ| graharkṣadaśano vāṇījivho vāsavanāsikaḥ|| 27||
bhrūmadhyasaṃsthitakaro brahmavidyā madotkaṭaḥ| kulācalāṃsaḥ somārkaghaṇṭo rudraśirodharaḥ|| 28||
nadīnadabhajaḥ sarpāṅgulīkastārakānakhaḥ| vyomanābhiḥ śrīhṛdayo merupṛṣṭho'rṇavodaraḥ|| 29||
kukṣisthayakṣagandharvarakṣaḥkinnaramānuṣaḥ| pṛthvīkaṭiḥ sṛṣṭiliṅgaḥ śailorurdrasrajānukaḥ|| 30||
pātālajaṅgho munipāt kālāṅguṣṭhasrayītanuḥ| jyotirmaṇḍalalāṅgulo hṛdayālānaniścalaḥ|| 31||
hatpadmakarṇikāśāliviyatkelisarovaraḥ| sadbhaktadhyānanigaḍaḥ pūjāvārinivāritaḥ|| 32||
pratāpī kaśyapasuto gaṇapo viṣṭapī balī| yaśasvī dhārmikaḥ svojā prathamaḥ prathameśvaraḥ|| 33||
cintāmaṇidvīpapatiḥ kalpadrumavanālayaḥ| ratnamaṇḍapamadhyastho ratnasiṃhāsanāśrayaḥ|| 34||
tīvrāśiroghṛtapado jvālinīmaulilālitaḥ| nandānanditapīṭhaśrīḥ bhogadābhūṣitāsanaḥ|| 35||
sakāmadāyinīpīṭhaḥ sphuradugrāsanāśrayaḥ| tejovatīśiroratnaṃ satyānityāvataṃsitaḥ|| 36||
savighnanāśinīpīṭhaḥ sarvaśaktyambujāśrayaḥ| lipipadmāsanādhāro vahnidhāmatrayāśrayaḥ|| 37||
unnataprapado gūḍhagulphaḥ saṃvṛtapārṣṇikaḥ| pīnajaṅghaḥ śliṣṭajānuḥ sthūloruḥ pronnamatkaṭiḥ|| 38||
nimnanābhiḥ sthūlakukṣiḥ pīnavakṣā bṛhadbhujaḥ| pīnaskandhaḥ kambukaṇṭho lamboṣṭho lambanāsikaḥ|| 39||
bhagnavāmaradastuṅga savyadanto mahāhanuḥ| hṛsvanetratrayaḥ śūrpakarṇo nibiḍamastakaḥ|| 40||
stabakākārakumbhāgro ratnamaulirniraṅkuśaḥ| sarpahārakaṭīsūtraḥ sarpayajñopavītavān|| 41||
sarpakoṭīrakaṭakaḥ sarpagraiveyakāṅgadaḥ| sarpakakṣodarābandhaḥ sarparājottarīyakaḥ|| 42||
rakto raktāmbaradharo raktamālyavibhūṣaṇaḥ| raktekṣaṇo raktakaro raktatātvoṣṭhapallavaḥ|| 43||
śvetaḥśvetāmbaradharaḥ śvetamālyavibhūṣaṇaḥ| śvetātapatraruciraḥ śvetacāmaravījitaḥ|| 44||
sarvāvayavasampūrṇaḥ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ| sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyaḥ sarvaśobhāsamanvitaḥ|| 45||
sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyaḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam| sarvadaikakaraḥśārṅgī bījapūrī gadādharaḥ|| 46||
śuklāṅgo lokasukhadaḥ sutantustantuvardhanaḥ| kirīṭī kuṇḍalīhārī vanamālī śubhāṃgadaḥ|| 47||
ikṣucāpadharaḥ śūlī cakrapāṇiḥ sarojabhṛt| pāśī dhṛtotpalaḥśālīmañjarībhṛtsvadantabhṛt|| 48||
kalpavallīdharo viśvābhayadaikakarovaśī| akṣamālādharo jñānamudrāvān mudgarāyudhaḥ|| 49||
pūrṇapātrī kambudharo vidhṛtālisamūhakaḥ| mātuliṅgadharaścūtakalikābhṛt kuṭhāravān|| 50||
puṣkarasthasvarṇaghaṭīpūrṇaratnābhivarṣakaḥ| bhāratīsundarīnātho vināyakaratipriyaḥ|| 51||
mahālakṣmīpriyatamaḥ siddhalakṣmīmanoramaḥ| ramārameśapūrvāṅgo dakṣiṇomāmaheśvaraḥ|| 52||
mahivarāhavāmāṅgo ratikandarpapaścimaḥ| āmodamodajananaḥ sapramodapramodanaḥ|| 53||
samedhitasamṛddhi śrīrriddhisiddhipravarttakaḥ| dattasaumukhyasumukhaḥ kāntikandalitāśrayaḥ|| 54||
madanāvatyāśritāṅghriḥ kṛtadaurmukhyadurmukhaḥ| vighnasampallavopaghnaḥ sevonnidramadadravaḥ|| 55||
vighnakṛnnighnacaraṇo drāviṇīśaktisatkṛtaḥ| (śaktisaṃvṛtaḥ) tīvrāprasannanayano jvālinīpālitaikadṛk|| 56||
mohinīmohano bhogadāyinī kāntimaṇḍitaḥ| kāminīkāntavaktraśrīradhiṣṭhitavasundharaḥ|| 57|| (yuktaśrīstejinyadhiṣṭhitaikadṛk) vasundharāmadonnaddha mahāśaṅkhanidhiprabhuḥ| (nidhipriyaḥ) namadvasumatīmaulimahāpadmanidhiprabhuḥ|| 58||
sarvasadgurūsaṃsevyaḥ śociṣkeśahṛdāśrayaḥ| īśānamūrdhā devendraśikhaḥ pavananandanaḥ|| 59||
agrapratyagranayano divyāstrāṇāṃ prayogavit| airāvatādisarvāśāvāvāraṇāvaraṇapriyaḥ|| 60||
vajrādyastraparīvāro gaṇacaṇḍasamāśrayaḥ| jayājayaparīvāro vijayāvijayāvahaḥ|| 61||
ajitārcitapādābjo nityānityāvataṃsitaḥ| vilāsinīkṛtollāsaḥśauṇḍīsaundaryamaṇḍitaḥ|| 62||
anantānantasukhadaḥ sumaṅgalasumaṅgalaḥ| icchāśaktijñānaśaktikriyāśaktiniṣevitaḥ|| 63||
subhagāsaṃśrītapadaḥ lalitālalitāśrayaḥ| kāminīkāmanaḥ kāmamālinīkelilālitaḥ|| 64||
sarasvatyāśrayo gaurīnandanaḥ śrīniketanaḥ| guruguptapado vācāsiddho vāgīśvarīpatiḥ|| 65||
nalinīkāmuko vāmārāmo jyeṣṭhāmanoramaḥ| raudrīmudritapādābjo humbījastuṅgaśaktikaḥ|| 66||
viśvādijananatrāṇaḥ svāhāśaktiḥ sakīlakaḥ| amṛtābdhikṛtāvāso madaghūrṇitalocanaḥ|| 67||
ucchiṣṭagaṇa ucchiṣṭagaṇeśo gaṇanāyakaḥ| sārvakālikasaṃsiddhiḥ nityaśaivo digambaraḥ|| 68||
anāpāyo'nantadṛṣṭiraprameyo'jarāmaraḥ| anāvilo'pratiratho hyacyuto'mṛtamakṣaram|| 69||
apratarkyo'kṣayo'jayyo'nādhāro'nāmayo'malaḥ| amoghasiddhiradvaitamaghoro'pramitānanaḥ|| 70||
anākāro'bdhibhūmyagnibalaghno'vyaktalakṣaṇaḥ| ādhārapīṭhaḥ ādhāraḥ ādhārādheyavarjitaḥ|| 71||
ākhuketana āśāpūraka ākhumahārathaḥ| ikṣusāgaramadhyasthaḥ ikṣubhakṣaṇalālasaḥ|| 72||
ikṣucātirekaśrīrikṣucāpaniṣevitaḥ| 73||
indragopasamānaśrīrindranīlasamadyutiḥ| indīvaradalaśyāma indumaṇḍalanirmalaḥ|| 74||
idhmapriya iḍābhāga iḍādhāmendirāpriyaḥ| ikṣvākuvighnavidhvaṃsī itikartavyatepsitaḥ|| 75||
īśānamaulirīśāna īśānasuta ītihā| īṣaṇātrayakalpānta īhāmātravivarjitaḥ|| 75||
upendra uḍubhṛnmauliruṇḍerakabalipriyaḥ| unnatānana uttuṅga udāratridaśāgraṇīḥ|| 77||
ūrjasvān ūṣmalamada ūhāpohadurāsadaḥ| ṛgyajuḥ sāmasambhūtirriddhisiddhipravartakaḥ|| 78||
ṛjucittaikasulabha ṛṇatrayavimocakaḥ| luptavighnaḥ svabhaktānāṃ luptaśaktiḥsuradviṣām|| 79||
luptaśrīrvimukhārcānāṃlūtāvisphoṭanāśanaḥ| ekārapīṭhamadhyastha ekapādakṛtāsanaḥ|| 80||
ejitākhiladaitya śrīrejitākhilasaṃśraya| aiśvaryanidhiraiśvaryamaihikāmuṣmikapradaḥ|| 81||
airammadasamonmeṣa airāvatanibhānanaḥ| oṃkāravācya oṃkāra ojasvānoṣadhīpatiḥ|| 82||
audāryanidhirauddhatyadhurya aunnatyaniḥsvanaḥ| aṅkuśaḥsuranāgānāmaṅkuśaḥsuravidviṣām|| 83||
aḥsamastavisargānta padeṣu parikīrtitaḥ| kamaṇḍaludharaḥ kalpaḥ kapardī kalabhānanaḥ|| 84||
karmasākṣī karmakartā karmākarmaphalapradaḥ| kadambagolakākāraḥkūṣmāṇḍagaṇanāyakaḥ|| 85||
kāruṇyadehaḥ kapilaḥ kathakaḥ kaṭisūtrabhṛt| kharvaḥkhaḍgapriyaḥkhaḍga khātāntasthaḥkhanirmalaḥ|| 86||
khalvāṭaśṛṅganilayaḥkhaṭvāṅgī khadurāsadaḥ| guṇāḍhyo gahano gastho gadyapadyasudhārṇavaḥ|| 87||
gadyagānapriyo garjo gītagīrvāṇapūrvajaḥ| guhyācārarato guhyo guhyāgamanirūpitaḥ|| 88||
guhāśayo guhābdhistho gurugamyo gurorguruḥ| ghaṇṭāghargharikāmālī ghaṭakumbho ghaṭodaraḥ|| 89||
ṅakāravācyo ṅākāro ṅakārākāraśuṇḍabhṛt| caṇḍaścaṇḍeśvarasuhṛt caṇḍīśaścaṇḍavikramaḥ|| 90||
carācarapatiścintāmaṇiścarvaṇalālasaḥ| chandaśchandovapuśchando durlakṣyaśchandavigrahaḥ|| 91||
jagadyonirjagatsākṣī jagadīśojaganmayaḥ| japojapaparo jāpyo jihvāsiṃhāsanaprabhuḥ|| 92||
jhalajhjhallollasaddānajhaṅkāribhramarākulaḥ| ṭaṅkārasphārasaṃrāvaṣṭaṅkārimaṇinūpuraḥ|| 93||
ṭhadvayīpallavāntasthaḥsarvamantraikasiddhidaḥ| ḍiṇḍimuṇḍo ḍākinīśo ḍāmaro ḍiṇḍimapriyaḥ|| 94||
ḍhakkāninādamudito ḍhaukau ḍhuṇḍhivināyakaḥ|| 95||
tattvānāṃ paramaṃ tattvaṃ tattvaṃ padanirūpitaḥ| tārakāntarasaṃsthānastārakastārakāntakaḥ|| 96||
sthāṇuḥsthāṇupriyaḥsthātāsthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ jagat| dakṣayajñapramathano dātā dānavamohanaḥ|| 97||
dayāvān divyavibhavo daṇḍabhṛddṇḍanāyakaḥ| dantaprabhinnābhramālo daityavāraṇadāraṇaḥ|| 98||
daṃṣṭrālagnadvipaghaṭo devārthanṛgajākṛtiḥ| dhanadhānyapatirdhanyo dhanado dharaṇīdharaḥ|| 99||
dhyānaikaprakaṭo dhyeyo dhyānaṃ dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ| dhvaniprakṛticītkārabrahmāṇḍāvalimekhalaḥ|| 100||
nando nandipriyo nādo nādamadhye pratiṣṭhitaḥ| niṣkalo nirmalo nityo nityānityo nirāmayaḥ|| 101||
paraṃvyoma paraṃdhāma paramātmā paraṃpadam|
parātparaḥ paśupatiḥ paśupāśavimocakaḥ|| 102||
pūrṇānandaḥ parānandaḥ purāṇapuruṣottamaḥ| padmaprasannanayanaḥ praṇatājñānamocanaḥ|| 103||
pramāṇapratyayātītaḥ praṇatārtinivāraṇaḥ| phalahastaḥ phaṇipatiḥ phetkāraḥ phāṇitapriyaḥ|| 104||
bāṇārcitāṅghriyugulo bālakelīkutūhalī| brahma brahmārcitapado brahmacārī bṛhaspatiḥ|| 105||
bṛhattamo brahmaparo brahmaṇyo brahmavitpriyaḥ| bṛhannādāgryacītkāro brahmāṇḍāvalimekhalaḥ|| 106||
bhrūkṣepadattalakṣmīko bhargo bhadro bhayāpahaḥ||
bhagavān bhaktisulabho bhūtido bhūtibhūṣaṇaḥ|| 107||
bhavyo bhūtālayo bhogadātā bhrūmadhyagocaraḥ| mantro mantrapatirmantrī madamattamanoramaḥ|| 108||
mekhavān mandagatirmatimatkamalekṣaṇaḥ| mahābalo mahāvīryo mahāprāṇo mahāmanāḥ|| 109||
yajño yajñapatiryajñagoptā yajñaphalapradaḥ| yaśaskaro yogagamyo yājñiko yācakapriyaḥ|| 110||
raso rasapriyo rasyo rañjako rāvaṇārcitaḥ||
rakṣorakṣākaro ratnagarbho rājyasukhapradaḥ|| 111||
lakṣyaṃ lakṣyaprado lakṣyo layastho laḍḍukapriyaḥ||
lānapriyo lāsyaparo lābhakṛllokaviśrutaḥ|| 112||
vareṇyo vahnivadano vandyo vedāntagocaraḥ||
vikartā viśvataścakṣurvidhātā viśvatomukhaḥ|| 113||
vāmadevo viśvanetā vajrivajranivāraṇaḥ||
viśvabandhana viṣkambhādhāro viśveśvaraḥ vibhuḥ|| 114||
śabdabrahmaśamaprāpyaḥ śambhuśaktigaṇeśvaraḥ||
śāstā śikhāgranilayaḥ śaraṇyaḥ śikharīśvaraḥ|| 115||
ṣaḍ ṛtukusumasragvī ṣaḍādhāraḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ||
saṃsāravaidyaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvabheṣajabheṣajam|| 116||
sṛṣṭisthitilayakrīḍaḥ surakuñjarabhedanaḥ||
sindūritamahākumbhaḥ sadasadvyaktidāyakaḥ|| 117||
sākṣī samudramathanaḥ svasaṃvedyaḥ svadakṣiṇaḥ||
svatantraḥ satyasaṅkalpaḥ sāmagānarataḥ sukhī|| 118||
haṃso hastipiśācīśo havanaṃ havyakavyabhuk||
havyaṃ hutapriyo harṣo hṛllekhāmantramadhyagaḥ|| 119||
kṣetrādhipaḥ kṣamābhartā kṣamāparapararāyaṇam||
kṣiprakṣemakaraḥ kṣemānandaḥ kṣoṇīsuradrumaḥ|| 120||
dharmaprado'rthadaḥ kāmadātā saubhāgyavardhanaḥ||
vidyāprado vibhavado bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ|| 121||
ābhirūpyakaro vīraśrīprado vijayapradaḥ||
sarvavaśyakaro garbhadoṣahāputrapautradaḥ|| 122||
medhādaḥ kīrtidaḥ śokahārī daurbhāgyanāśanaḥ||
śrīśokahārī daurbhāgyanāśanaḥ sarvaśaktibhṛt|| 123||
prativādimukhastambho ruṣṭacittaprasādanaḥ| parābhicāraśamano duḥkhabhañjanakārakaḥ|| 124||
lavastruṭiḥ kalā kāṣṭhā nimeṣastatparakṣaṇaḥ| ghaṭīmuhūrta praharo divānaktamaharniśam|| 125||
pakṣomāso'yanaṃ varṣaṃ yugaṃ kalpomahālayaḥ| rāśistārā tithiryogo vāraḥ karaṇamaṃśakam|| 126||
lagnaṃ horā kālacakraṃ meruḥ saptarṣayo dhruvaḥ| rāhurmandaḥ kavirjīvo budho bhaumaḥ śaśī raviḥ|| 127||
kālaḥ sṛṣṭiḥ sthitirviśvaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca yat| bhūrāpo'gnirmarudvyomāhaṅkṛtiḥ prakṛtiḥ pumān|| 128||
brahmā viṣṇuḥ śivo rudra īśaḥ śaktiḥ sadāśivaḥ| tridaśāḥ pitaraḥ siddhā yakṣā rakṣāṃsi kinnarāḥ|| 129||
sādhyā vidyādhara bhūtā manuṣyāḥ paśavaḥ khagāḥ| samudrāḥ saritaḥ śailā bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavodbhavaḥ|| 130||
sāṅkhyaṃ pātañjalaṃ yogaḥ purāṇāni śrutiḥ smṛtiḥ| vedāṅgāni sadācāro mīmāṃsā nyāyavistaraḥ|| 131||
āyurvedo dhanurvedo gāndharvaṃ kāvyanāṭakam| vaikhānasaṃ bhāgavataṃ sātvataṃ pāñcarātrakam|| 132||
śaivaṃ pāśupataṃ kālamukhaṃ bhairavaśāsanam| śāktaṃ vaināyaka sauraṃ jainamārhatasaṃhitā|| 133||
sadasad vyaktamavyaktaṃ sacetanamacetanam| bandho mokṣaḥ sukhaṃ bhogo'yogaḥ satyamaṇurmahān|| 134||
svasti huṃ phaṭ svadhā svāhā śrauṣaḍvauṣaḍvaṣaṇnamaḥ| jñānaṃ vijñānamānando bodhaḥ saṃvicchamo yamaḥ|| 135||
eka ekākṣarādhāra ekākṣaraparāyaṇaḥ| ekāgradhīrekavīra ekānekasvarūpadhṛk|| 136||
dvirūpo dvibhujo dvyakṣo dviradodvīparakṣakaḥ| dvaimāturo dvivadano dvandvātīto dvayātigaḥ|| 137||
tridhāmāstrikarasretātrivargaphaladāyakaḥ| triguṇātmā trilokādistriśaktīśastrilocanaḥ|| 138||
caturbāhuścaturdataścaturātmā caturmukhaḥ| caturvidhopāyamayaścaturvarṇāśramāśrayaḥ|| 139||
caturvidhavacovṛttiparivṛttipravartakaḥ| caturthīpūjanaprītaḥ caturthītithi sambhavaḥ|| 140||
pañcākṣarātmā pañcātmā pañcāsya pañcakṛtyakṛt| pañcādhāraḥ pañcavarṇaḥ pañcākṣaraparāyaṇaḥ|| 141||
pañcatālaḥ pañcakaraḥ pañcapraṇavabhāvitaḥ| pañcabrahmamayasphūrtiḥ pañcavāraṇavāritaḥ|| 142||
pañcabhakṣyapriyaḥ pañcabāṇaḥ pañcaśivātmakaḥ| ṣaṭkoṇapīṭhaḥ ṣaṭcakradhāmā ṣaḍgranthibhedakaḥ|| 143||
ṣaḍadhvadhvāntavidhvaṃsī ṣaḍaṅgulamahāhṛdaḥ| ṣaṇmukhaḥ ṣaṇmukhabhrātā ṣaṭśaktiparivāritaḥ|| 144||
ṣaḍvairivargavidhvaṃsī ṣaḍūrmibhayabhañjanaḥ| ṣaṭtarkadūraḥ ṣaṭkarmanirataḥ ṣaḍrasāśrayaḥ|| 145||
saptapātālacaraṇaḥ saptadvīporumaṇḍalaḥ| saptasvarlokamukuṭaḥ saptasaptivarapradaḥ|| 146||
saptāṅgarājyasukhadaḥ saptarṣigaṇamaṇḍitaḥ| saptacchandonidhīḥ saptahotā saptasvarāśrayaḥ|| 147||
saptābdhikelikāsāraḥ saptamātṛniṣevitaḥ| saptacchandomodamadaḥ saptacchandomakhaprabhuḥ|| 148||
aṣṭamūrtidhyeyamūrtiraṣṭaprakṛtikāraṇam| aṣṭāṅgayogaphalabhūraṣṭapatrāmbujāsanaḥ|| 149||
aṣṭaśaktisamṛddhaśrīraṣṭaiśvaryapradāyakaḥ| aṣṭhapīṭhopapīṭhaśrīraṣṭamātṛsamāvṛtaḥ|| 150||
aṣṭabhairavasevyo'ṣṭavasuvandyo'ṣṭamūrtibhṛt| aṣṭacakrasphuranmūrtiraṣṭadravyahaviḥpriyaḥ|| 151||
navanāgāsanādhyāsī navanidhyanuśāsitā| navadvārapurādhāro navadvāraniketanaḥ|| 152||
navanārāyaṇastutyo navadurgāniṣevitaḥ| navanāthamahānātho navanāgavibhūṣaṇaḥ|| 153||
navaratnavicitrāṅgo navaśaktiśirodhṛtaḥ| daśātmako daśabhujo daśadikpativanditaḥ|| 154||
daśādhyāyo daśaprāṇo daśendriyaniyāmakaḥ| daśākṣaramahāmantro daśāśāvyāpivigrahaḥ|| 155||
ekādaśamahārudraiḥ stutaekādaśākṣaraḥ| dvādaśoddṇḍadordaṇḍo dvādaśāntaniketanaḥ|| 156||
trayodaśabhidābhinna viśvedevādhidaivatam| caturdaśendravaradaścaturdaśamanuprabhuḥ|| 157||
caturdaśādividyāḍhyaścaturdaśajagatprabhuḥ| sāmapañcadaśaḥ pañcadaśīśītāṃśunirmalaḥ|| 158||
ṣoḍaśādhāranilayaḥ ṣoḍaśasvaramātṛkaḥ| ṣoḍaśāntapadāvāsaḥ ṣoḍaśendukalātmakaḥ|| 159||
kalāsaptadaśīsaptadaśaḥ saptadaśākṣaraḥ| aṣṭādaśadvīpapatiraṣṭādaśapurāṇakṛt|| 160||
aṣṭādaśauṣadhisṛṣṭiraṣṭādaśavidhismṛtaḥ| aṣṭādaśalipivyaṣṭisamaṣṭijñānakovidaḥ|| 161||
ekaviṃśaḥ pumānekaviṃśatyaṅgulipallavaḥ| caturviṃśatitattvātmā pañcaviśākhya pūruṣaḥ|| 162||
saptaviṃśatitāreśaḥ saptaviṃśatiyogakṛt| dvātriṃśadbhairavādhīśaścatustriṃśanmahāhṛdaḥ|| 163||
ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasambhūtiraṣṭatriṃśatkalātanuḥ| namadekonapañcāśanmarudvargonirargalaḥ|| 164||
pañcāśadakṣaraśreṇīḥ pañcāśadrudravigrahaḥ| pañcāśadviṣṇuśaktīśaḥ pañcāśanmātṛkālayaḥ|| 165||
dvipañcāśadvapuḥśreṇīstriṣaṣṭayakṣarasaṃśrayaḥ| catuḥṣaṣṭyarṇanirṇetā catuḥṣaṣṭikalānidhiḥ|| 166||
catuḥṣaṣṭimahāsiddhayoginīvṛndavanditaḥ| aṣṭaṣaṣṭimahātīrthakṣetrabhairavabhāvanaḥ|| 167||
caturnavatimantrātmā ṣaṇṇavatyadhikaḥprabhuḥ| śatānandaḥ śatadhṛtiḥ śatapatrāyatekṣaṇaḥ|| 168||
śatānīkaḥ śatamakhaḥ śatadhāravarāyudhaḥ| sahasrapatranilayaḥ sahasraphaṇabhūṣaṇaḥ|| 169||
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt| sahasranāmasaṃstutyaḥ sahasrākṣabalāpahaḥ|| 170||
daśasahasraphaṇibhṛt phaṇirājakṛtāsanaḥ| aṣṭāśītisahasraughamaharṣistotrayantritaḥ|| 171||
lakṣādhīśapriyādhāro lakṣādhīśamanomayaḥ| caturlakṣajapaprītaḥ caturlakṣaprakāśitaḥ|| 172||
caturāśītilakṣāṇāṃ jīvānāṃ dehasaṃsthitaḥ| koṭisūryapratīkāśaḥ koṭicandrāṃśunirmalaḥ|| 173||
śivābhavādhyuṣṭakoṭivināyakadhurandharaḥ| saptakoṭimahāmantramantritāvayavadyutiḥ|| 174||
trayastriṃśat koṭisuraśreṇī praṇatapādukaḥ| anantadevatāsevyo hyanantamunisaṃstutaḥ|| 175||
anantānāmānantaśrīranantānantasaukhyadaḥ| anantaśaktisahito hyanantamunisaṃstutaḥ| anantamunisaṃstuta oṃ nama iti| oṃ iti vaināyakaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasramidamīritam|| 176||
idaṃ brāhmemuhūrte vai yaḥ paṭhet pratyahaṃ naraḥ| karasthaṃ tasya sakalamaihikāmuṣmikaṃ sukham|| 177||
āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ dhairya śaurya balaṃ yaśaḥ| medhā prajñā dhṛtiḥ kāntiḥ saubhāgyamatirūpatā|| 178||
satyaṃ dayā kṣamā śāntirdākṣiṇyaṃ dharmaśīlatā| jagatsaṃyamanaṃ viśvasaṃvādo vādapāṭavam|| 179||
sabhāpāṇḍityamaudāryaṃ gāmbhīryaṃ brahmavarcasam||
aunnatyaṃca kulaṃ śīlaṃ pratāpo vīryamāryatā|| 180||
jñānaṃ vijñānamāstikyaṃ dhairyaṃ viśvātiśāyitā| dhanadhānyābhivṛddhiśca sakṛdasya japādbhavet|| 181||
vaśyaṃ caturvidhaṃ nṝṇāṃ japādasya prajāyate||
rājño rājakalatrasya rājaputrasya mantriṇaḥ|| 182||
japyeta yasya vaśyārthe sa dāsastasya jāyate||
dharmārthakāmamokṣaṇāmanāyāsena sādhanam|| 183||
śākinīḍākinīrakṣoyakṣoragabhayāpaham||
sāmrājyasukhadaṃ caiva samastaripumardanam|| 184||
samastakalahadhvaṃsī dagdhabījaprarohaṇam| duḥsvapnapraśamanaṃ kruddhasvāmicittaprasādanam|| 185||
ṣaṭkarmāṣṭamahāsiddhitrikālajñānasādhanam| parakṛtyopaśamanaṃ paracakravimardanam|| 186||
saṃgrāmaraṅge sarveṣāmidamekaṃ jayāvaham||
sarvavandhyātvadoṣaghnaṃ garbharakṣaikakāraṇam|| 187||
paṭhyate pratyahaṃ yatra stotraṃ gaṇapateridam||
deśe tatra na durbhikṣaramītayo duritāni ca|| 188||
na tadgehaṃ jahāti śrīryatrāyaṃ japyate stavaḥ||
kṣayakuṣṭhapramehārśo bhagandaraviṣūcikāḥ|| 189||
gulmaṃ plīhānamaśmāna matisāraṃ mahaudaram||
kāsaṃ śvāsamudāvarttaṃ śūlaṃ śophādisambhavam|| 190||
śirorogaṃ vamiṃ hikkāṃ gaṇḍamālāmarocakam||
vātapittakaphadvandvatridoṣajanitajvaram|| 191||
āgantuṃ viṣamaṃ śītamuṣṇaṃ caikāhikādikam||
ityādyuktamanuktaṃ vā roga doṣādisambhavam|| 192||
sarvaṃ praśamayatyāśu stotrasyāsya sakṛjjapaḥ||
sakṛtpāṭhena saṃsiddhaḥ strīśūdrapatitairapi|| 193|| (prāpyate'sya japāt siddhiḥ strīśūdrapatitaiḥsakṛt|| 193||)
sahasranāmamantro'yaṃ japtavyastu śubhāptaye||
mahāgaṇapateḥ stotraṃ sakāmaḥ prajapannidam|| 194||
icchayā sakalān bhogānupabhujyeha pārthivān||
manorathaphalairdivyairvyomayānairmanoramaiḥ|| 195||
candredrabhāskaropendrabrahmarudrādisadmasu||
kāmarūpaḥ kāmagatiḥ kāmato vicaranniha|| 196||
bhuktvā yathepsitān bhogānabhīṣṭaiḥ sahabandhubhiḥ| gaṇeśānucaro bhūtvā mahāgaṇapate priyaḥ|| 197||
nandīśvarādisānandī nanditaḥ sakalairgaṇaiḥ||
śivābhyāṃ kṛpayā putranirviśeṣaṃ ca lālitaḥ|| 198||
śivabhaktaḥ pūrṇakāmo gaṇeśvaravarāt punaḥ||
jātismaro dharmaparaḥ sārvabhaumo'bhijāyate|| 199||
niṣkāmastu japannityaṃ bhaktyā vighneśatatparaḥ||
yogasiddhiṃ parāṃ prāpya jñānavairāgya saṃsthitaḥ|| 200||
nirantaroditānande paramānandasaṃvidi||
viśvottīrṇe pare pāre punarāvṛttivarjite|| 201||
līno vaināyake dhāmni ramate nityanirvṛtaḥ||
yo nāmabhiḥ sahasrairmāmarcayetad pūjayennaraḥ|| 202||
rājāno vaśyatāṃ yānti ripavo yānti dāsatām| mantrāḥsiddhyanti sarvepi sulabhāstasya siddhayaḥ|| 203||
mūlamantrādapi stotramidaṃ priyataraṃ mama||
nabhasye māsi śuklāyāṃ caturthyāṃ mama janmani|| 204||
dūrvābhirnāmabhiḥ pūjāṃ tarpaṇaṃ vidhivaccaret| aṣṭadravyairviśeṣeṇa juhayād bhaktisaṃyutaḥ|| 205||
tasyepsitā nisarvāṇi siddhyantyatra na saṃśayaḥ| idaṃ prajaptaṃ paṭhitaṃ pāṭhitaṃ śrāvitaṃ śrutam|| 206||
vyākṛtaṃ carcitaṃ dhyātaṃ vimṛṣṭamabhinanditam||
ihāmutraca sarveṣāṃ sarvaiśvaryapradāyakam|| 207||
svacchandacāriṇā'pyeṣa yenāyaṃ dhāryate stavaḥ| sa rakṣyate śivodbhūtairgaṇairapyaṣṭakoṭibhiḥ|| 208||
pustake likhitaṃ stotraṃ mantrabhūtaṃ prapūjayet| tatra sarvottamā lakṣmīḥ sannidhatte nirantaram|| 209||
dānairaśeṣairakhilairvrataiśca tīrthairaśeṣairakhilairmakhaśca| na tatphalaṃ vindati yad gaṇeśasahasranāmnāṃ smaraṇena sadyaḥ|| 210||
etannāmnāṃ sahasraṃ paṭhati dinamaṇau pratyahaṃ projjihāne sāyaṃ madhyandine vā triṣavaṇamathavā santataṃ vā jano yaḥ| sa syādaiśvaryadhuryaḥ prabhavati vacasāṃ kīrtimuccaistanoti pratyūhaṃ hanti viśvaṃ vaśayati suciraṃ vardhate putrapautraiḥ|| 211||
akiñcano'pyekacitto niyato niyatāśanaḥ| japettu caturo māsān gaṇeśārcanatatparaḥ|| 212||
daridratāṃ samunmūlya saptajanmānugāmapi| labhate mahatīṃ lakṣmīmityājñā pārameśvarī|| 213||
āyuṣyaṃ vītarogaṃ kulamativimalaṃ sampadaścārtadānāḥ kīrtirnityāvadātā bhaṇatirabhinavā kāntiravyājabhavyā| putrāḥ santaḥ kalatraṃ guṇavadabhimataṃ yadyadetacca satyaṃ nityaṃ yaḥ stotrametat paṭhati gaṇapatestasya haste samastam|| 214||
oṃ gaṇañjayo gaṇapatirherambo dharaṇīdharaḥ| mahāgaṇapatirlakṣapradaḥ kṣipraprasādanaḥ|| 215||
amoghasiddhiramito mantraścintāmaṇirnidhiḥ| sumaṅgalo bījamāśāpūrako varadaḥ śivaḥ|| 216||
kāśyapo nandano vācā siddho ḍhuṇḍhirvināyakaḥ| modakairebhiratraikaviṃśatyā nāmabhiḥ pumān|| 219||
upāyanaṃ daded bhaktyāmatprasādaṃ cikīrṣati| vatsaraṃ vighnarājasya tathyamiṣṭārthasiddhaye|| 218||
yaḥ stauti madgatamanā madārādhatatparaḥ| stuto nāmnāṃ sahasreṇa tenāhaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ|| 219||
namo namaḥ suravarapūjitāṅghrye namo namo nirupamamaṅgalātmane| namo namo vipulakaraikasiddhaye namo namaḥ karikalabhānanāya te|| 220||
gaṇapājeśa heramba dvaimātura gajānana| bhālendo dhūmakṛd bhāno lambodara vināyaka|| 221||
brahmaikadanta vighneśa viṣṇo kapila nirguṇa||
kālādya siddhidānanta trāhi māṃ bhavasāgarāt|| 222||
kiṅkiṇīgaṇaracitastavacaraṇaḥ prakaṭitagurumiticāritragaṇaḥ| madajalalaharīkaritakapolaḥ śamayatu duritaṃ gaṇapatinṛpanāmnā|| 223||
iti śrīgaṇeśapurāṇe upāsanākhaṇḍe īśvaramahāgaṇapatisaṃvāde śrīmadgaṇeśadivyasahasranāmāmṛtastotrakathanannāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 46||
āditaḥ ślokānāṃ samaṣṭyaṅkāḥ 1744 + 223 = 1967
1.47 śivavijayonāma saptacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
vyāsa uvāca| nāmnāṃ sahasre samprāpte prasanne ca gajānane| tataḥ kimakarot brahman harastat kathayasva me|| 1||
brahmovāca| gaṇeśavaradānena nāmnāṃ caivopadeśataḥ| prahṛṣṭaḥ śaṅkaro'nṛtyad jagarja ca mahāsvanaḥ|| 2||
āhūya svagaṇāndevān yuddhāvasaramādiśat| te ca harṣeṇa mahatā yayurdevāḥ śivāntikam|| 3||
brahmā kubero'tha purandaro'gnirvāyuśca somovaruṇo'ryamāca| gandharvayakṣā grahakinnarāśca sarve namaskṛtya śivaṃ stuvantaḥ|| 4||
devā ūcuḥ| mahādeva jagannātha jagadānandadāyaka| tvayā hataṃ mahādaityaṃ kadā drakṣyāmahe vayam|| 5||
sthānabhraṣṭā vayaṃ tena kṛtā viśva vighātinā|
brahmovāca| evaṃ devavacaḥ śrutvā pinākī niryayau mudā|| 6||
gaṇeśaṃ manasā dhyāyan yuddhāya kṛtaniścayaḥ| vegena bhavanaṃ prāpya devagandharva saṃyutaḥ|| 7||
tāvacca daityaṃ cāraistu vṛttāntaḥ sannirūpitaḥ| āgataḥ surasainyena yuddhāya girijā patiḥ|| 8||
tasyasainyānyanahyanta śastrairastraiśca kañcukaiḥ| sa ca daityo mahānādo yuddhabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ|| 9||
vīrānānandayāmāsa vāsaḥ sragbhūṣaṇairghanaiḥ| anekayānasaṃstheṣu yoddhṛṣu tripuraṃ svayam|| 10||
āruroha mahādaityo nādayan vidiśo diśaḥ| tato yuddhaṃ samabhavat senayorubhayormahat|| 11||
śastrairnānāvidhairbāṇaiḥ marmabhedibhirāyasaiḥ| asṛṅnadīpravāho'bhūn mārgarodhanakārakaḥ|| 12||
śastrāhatā babhuryodhāḥ puṣpitāḥ kiṃśukā iva| kecicca dṛḍhavaireṇa jīvagrāhamamārayan|| 13||
kecitkaceṣu dhṛtvaiva śirāṃsi cicchidurbalāt| dhāvatāṃ rathivīrāṇāmaśvānāṃ kariṇāmapi|| 14||
aṅghripātabhavo reṇurvyānaśe rodasī kṣaṇāt| andhakāre ghoratare na prājñāyata kiñcana|| 15||
cakrurevaṃ tadā yuddhaṃ vīrā nānāvidhā bhṛśam| jīvitāśāṃ parityajya martavye kṛta niścayāḥ|| 16||
adṛśyanta mṛtā devā gate rajasi vāyunā| vidrute surasainye ca daityasainye ca harṣite|| 17||
āyayau samaraślāghī vajrahastaḥ purandaraḥ| śatakoṭiṃ nirīkṣyaiva dudruvurdaityadānavāḥ|| 18||
sa vajrapātairasurāṃścūrṇayāmāsa vajrabhṛta| tatyajurjīvitaṃ te tu caṇḍavajraprahārataḥ|| 19||
kecicca bhagnacaraṇāḥ kecid bhagnaśirodharāḥ| kecidvidīrṇa jaṭharāśchinnaskandhabhujāḥ pare|| 20||
chinnāśvānāṃ ca vīrāṇāṃ vājināṃ rathināṃ tathā| keṣāñciduravo bhinnā jaṅghāsu ca hatāḥ pare|| 21||
chinnagulphāḥ parepeturmiṣāt peturathāpare| nihatānāmasṛkpātairjajñire nimnagā bahu|| 22||
utsāhavardhanāsteṣāṃ vīrāṇāṃ jayakāṅkṣiṇām| tataḥ śanairgarjamāno dadarśa tripurāsuraḥ|| 23||
nihataṃ bahudhā sainyaṃ śakraṃ yoddhumathāyayau| babhāṇa śakraṃ dṛṣṭvaiva kimarthaṃ martumicchasi|| 24||
apaihi yuddhājjīvaṃstvaṃ na pṛṣṭhaṃ hanmi vāsava| kā te śaktirmayā yuddhaṃ kartuṃ tava śacīpate|| 25||
ajaḥ siṃhena kiṃ yuddhaṃ kariṣyati vadasva me| ehi yuddhasva śaktiścenno ced gaccha yathāsukham|| 26||
evamukte sthite śakre vavarṣe sāyakānbahūn| sajyaṅkṛtvā dhanurdaityo devasenāmatāḍayat|| 27||
ekasmānmantritādbāṇādasaṅkhyātā yayuḥ śarāḥ| mṛdganto devagandharvān rodasī samapūrayan|| 28|| (mṛdnanto?)
andhakāraṃ punarabhūt bāṇajālairnirantaram| tadbāṇairapi te devā vyaṅgāḥ peturdharātale|| 29||
balahānyapatat bhūmau prahāravapīḍitaḥ| sarveṣu devavaryeṣu mūrcchiteṣu maheśvaraḥ|| 30||
ślāghantaṃ bahugarjantaṃ yudhyantaṃ nā'bhyarocayat| manasā'pūjayacchambhustasya daityasya pauruṣam|| 31||
etasminnantare tatra nārado draṣṭumāyayau| pūjitaḥ prāvadacchambhuṃ śṛṇuṣva nīlalohita|| 32||
nārada uvāca| tvayā cintā na kartavyā tripurasya vadhaṃ prati| vakṣye tasya vadhopāyaṃ taṃ kuraṣva maheśvara|| 33||
tena pūrvaṃ tapo'kāri duṣkaraṃ brahmaṇo'pi hi| ārādhito gaṇapatiḥ sa tasmai sarvavāñchitam|| 34||
yadyattena vṛtaṃ devo dattavānavicāritam| puratrayaṃ kāmagamamekabāṇāśritaṃ mahat|| 35||
marudgativihīnaṃ tadabhedyaṃ sarvanirjaraiḥ| sa evamuktavān guhyaṃ śaraṇaikena yastava|| 36||
puratrayaṃ bhetsyate te tasmānmṛtyumavāpsyati| evamuktvā gate tasminnārade munisattame|| 37||
mūrchitānvibudhān śarvaḥ sāvadhānamathākarot| saṃsmārebhamukhaṃ vākyaṃ smārito nāradena tu|| 38||
mahāprayatnamārebhe daityarājavadhāya saḥ| tejasā sarvanāśāya śakto devo nijecchayā|| 39||
rathaṃ kurūpaṃ śaśisūryacakraṃ yaṃ tāramindīvarajaṃ cakāra| dhanurgirīndraṃ śaramacyutaṃ sa dhuryāśvineyāvayujad girīśaḥ|| 40||
ācamya devaṃ manasā vicintya tenopadiṣṭaṃ ca jajāpa nāmnām| sahasramekākṣaramantrayuktamamantrayattena pinākamugram|| 41||
amantrayanmahābāṇaṃ viṣṇurūpaṃ yadā śivaḥ| cakampe dharaṇī śeṣo vanāni girayo'pi ca|| 42||
babhramuḥ khagaṇāḥ sarve cukūjuśca mahāravān| śabdenā jagavasyāpi vibhrāntāḥ suramānuṣāḥ|| 43||
amuñcattaṃ yadā bāṇaṃ tadā dagdhaṃ nabhastalam| bhūmaṇḍalaṃ sapātālaṃ jvālāmālābhirañjasā|| 44||
dṛṣṭvā papāla daityendraḥ sasainyaḥ purasaṃśrayaḥ| javenāgāccharaḥ so'pya dahaddaityaṃ puratrayam|| 45||
daityadehagataṃ tejo bhargadehe layaṃ yayau| paśyatāṃ sarva sainyānāṃ daityadānavarakṣasām|| 46||
tato'ntarikṣe vāgāsīn mukto daityaḥ śivāhataḥ| tataste tuṣṭuvurdevā munayo'pi trilocanam|| 47||
jagurgandharvanicayāścāraṇāḥ śrutitatparāḥ| natṛtuścāpsaraḥ saṅghāḥ kinnarā vādyavādakāḥ|| 48||
mumucuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi nāradādyāḥ surarṣayaḥ| yayuḥ śivājñayā devāḥ svaṃ svaṃ sthāna nirādhayaḥ|| 49||
namaskṛtya maheśānaṃ tripurāsuraghātinam| munayo'pi nirudvegāḥ svasvānuṣṭhānatatparāḥ|| 50||
āsaṃstasminhate daitye vedavedāṅgaśālinaḥ| agnihotrāṇi yajñāṃśca dānāni ca vratāni ca|| 51||
cakruḥ sarvajanā bhūmau punarutsāhasaṃyutāḥ| śailādigaṇapaskandraiḥ sarvaiḥ pāriṣadairapi|| 52||
kṛtāvanāmasryakṣyo'pi vibhajya taṃ mahāratham| jayaśabdaistūryaśabdairdevadundubhinisvanaiḥ|| 53||
alaṅkṛtaṃ śailarājaṃ kailāsaṃ mudito yayau| tripurāririti spaṣṭaṃ tato nāmāsya paprathe|| 54||
evaṃ mahāgaṇapatermantra sāmarthyamīritam| sahasranāmnāmapi ca prabhāvo'yaṃ nirūpitaḥ|| 55||
brahmovāca| na vijñāto madanyena kasyāpi na niveditaḥ| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya sarvakāma phalaṃ labhet|| 56||
iti śrīgaṇeśapurāṇe upāsanākhaṇḍe śivavijayonāma saptacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 47||
āditaḥ ślokānāṃ samaṣṭyaṅkāḥ 1967 + 56 = 2023
1.48 ambāvirbhāvonāma aṣṭacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
vyāsa uvāca| śrutaṃ mayā mahākhyānaṃ tripurasya vadhāśrayam| tathāpi śrotumicchāmi kva sthitā jagadambikā|| 1||
kathamāvirbabhūvaiṣā tithau dagdhaḥ kva daityarāṭ| etatsarvaṃ savistāraṃ kathayasva pitāmaha|| 2||
brahmovāca| bāhule paurṇamāsyāṃ sa sāyaṃ dagdho mahāsuraḥ| divāyuddhaṃ mahāghoraṃ prāgeva varṇitaṃ hi tat|| 3||
yato'rcitaḥ suraiḥ sarvairjayaśālī surārihā| atastasyāṃ dīpadānaṃ kurvanti bhuvi mānavāḥ|| 4||
tasyāṃ snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca japahomādikaṃ ca yat| bahulaṃ jāyate yasmāt tasmāt sā bāhulī smṛtā|| 5||
tasyāṃ ye tu na kurvanti tripurārimahotsavam| na labhante jayaṃ kvāpi dagdhapuṇyā bhavanti te|| 6||
atastasyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ prātararcanti ye śivam| niśi yattaiḥ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vilayaṃ pratipadyate|| 7||
ājanmataḥ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ madhyānhārcanatastathā| saptajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ pradoṣārcanato mune|| 8||
āvirbhāvaṃ śivāyāstvaṃ kathyamānaṃ mayā śṛṇu| tasya mṛtyuṃ śivājjñātvāṃ bhayādantarhitā śivā|| 9||
āvirāsījjaganmātā himācalaguhāmukhāt| dadarśa parvataṃ ghoraṃ siṃhavyāghramṛgākulam|| 10||
apaśyantī śivaṃ sā tu virahākulamānasā| vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ bhītā hā tāta hā śiveti ca|| 11||
kathaṃ māṃ na vijānīṣe sarvajñaḥ san sadāśiva| vana ekākinīṃ ghore krandantī kurarīmiva|| 12||
kadā me darśanaṃ te syāt kiṃ māṃ vismṛtavānasi| śaktā na jīvitaṃ dhartuṃ soḍhuṃ vā virahaṃ hara|| 13||
tāta ttvamapi kutrāsi na me śokaṃ śruṇoṣi kim| tvāṃ vinā śaraṇaṃ kaṃ vā yāmi kiṃ vā karomyaham|| 14||
yojayasva punarmāṃ tvaṃ śivena ca śivena ca| idānīṃ punarutpannāṃ jānīhi jaṭharāt tava|| 15||
varaṃ tameva śīghraṃ me gaveṣaya sadāśivam| no ced dehaparityāgaṃ bhṛgorasmāt karomyaham|| 16||
ka uvāca| evaṃ rudantyāstasyāstu śrutvā tāṃ giramuttamām| nyavedayaddhimavate kaścidāgatya dhīvaraḥ|| 17||
dhīvara uvāca| kācinnitammbinī bālā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā| tāṭake bibhratī śrutyormaṇḍale iva bhāsvataḥ|| 18||
nānāratnalasaddīpti mukuṭaṃ mastake bhṛśam| lalāṭe tu catuṣkoṇaṃ muktāṣoḍaśaśobhitam|| 19||
puṣpaṃ kāñcanaratnāḍhyaṃ muktādāma vilambitam| sīmantāntargataṃ cāru nāsike svarṇamauktikam|| 20||
aṅgade cāruṇī bāhvorhastayorvalayāni ca| lasatkāñcanaratnāḍhyaṃ pratyekamaṅgulīyakam|| 21||
muktāphalamayīṃ mālāṃ lasatkañcukasaṃśritām| hemaratnamayīṃ kāñcīṃ kaṭau kṣaumāvṛte śubhām|| 22||
gulphayoḥ śṛṅkhale haime siñjaccārūsunūpare| pādāṅgulīṣvapi pṛthak tattadbhūṣaṇamuttamam|| 23||
evaṃ sarvānavadyāṅgī rūdatī vivhalā bhṛśam| dṛṣṭā pṛṣṭhā na māṃ vakti gṛhṇāti sā tavābhidhām|| 24||
brahmovāca| itthaṃ niśamya himavāṃstvaritastāṃ sutāṃ yayau| sāntvayan hetugarbhābhirvāgbhistāmavadatsudhīḥ|| 25||
himavānuvāca| kimarthaṃ śocase subhru sṛṣṭisthityantahetuke| sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇe sarvaśaktiyute'naghe|| 26||
akartumanyathākartuṃ kartumīśe maheśvari| avāptasarvakāme ca sarvaprāṇyantaraṃ gate|| 27||
na viyuktā śivena tvaṃ sarvāntaryāmiṇī śubhe| athāpi yojayiṣye tvāṃ śivena śivakāriṇā|| 28||
uttiṣṭheti gṛhītvā tāmāyayau nijamandiram| nananda pārvatī tatra dṛṣṭvā menāṃ sutānvitām|| 29||
niśvāsaparamā'pyāsīcchivaṃ draṣṭuṃ samutsukā| uvāca pitaraṃ natvā sādhūpāyaṃ vadasva me|| 30||
vrataṃ dānaṃ tapo vāpi duṣkaraṃ śivalabdhaye| kariṣye tamahaṃ tāta pūrvavattapa uttamam|| 31||
brahmovāca| avadajjanakastāṃ tu vicārya manasā sakṛt| kāryasiddhikaraṃ śīghramupāyaṃ śṛṇu taṃ mune|| 32||
himavānuvāca| śṛṇu pārvati vakṣyāmi sādhūpāyaṃ śivāptaye| upāstiṃ vighnarājasya dharmārthakāmamokṣadām|| 33||
anuṣṭhitāṃ mahendrādyaiḥ devaiśca nāradādibhiḥ| prāptāśca siddhayastāstāḥ śakrādipadalakṣaṇāḥ|| 34||
brahmaṇaḥ sṛṣṭisāmarthyaṃ dattaṃ tena mahātmanā| viṣṇoścāvanasāmarthyaṃ dattaṃ sarveśveraṇa ha|| 35||
śivasyāpi ca tenaiva sāmarthyaṃ saṃhṛtau dṛḍham| śeṣasyāpi ca tenaiva sarvavighnahareṇa ca|| 36||
dharādharaṇasāmarthyaṃ dattaṃ sarveśvareṇa ha| yasya svarūpaṃ na vidurbrahmādyā munayo'pi ca|| 37||
vācāmagocaro yo'sau manaso'thāpyagocaraḥ| gajānanasvarūpeṇa paridṛṣyo'yamīśvaraḥ|| 38||
atastenaiva rūpeṇa sarvārambheṣu pūjyate| tamupāsasva sarveśaṃ mayā proktena vartmanā|| 39||
iti śrīgaṇeśapurāṇe upāsanākhaṇḍe ambāvirbhāvonāma aṣṭacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 48||
āditaḥ ślokānāṃ samaṣṭyaṅkāḥ 2023 + 39 = 2062
1.49 gaṇeśa pārthivapūjā nirūpaṇaṃ nāmaikona pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
pārvatyuvāca| dayānidhe girīndra tvaṃ pitarme vada satvaram| upāsanāṃ gaṇeśasya sarveśasya jagadguroḥ|| 1||
yayā śivaṃ samabhyetya śivaṃ prāpsyāmi śāśvatam| martyaloke'pi lokānāmupakāro bhaviṣyati|| 2||
himavānuvāca| tavasnehavaśāddevi rahasyaṃ paramaṃ śubham| lokānāṃ copakārāya vakṣye śṛṇvekacetasā|| 3||
pratyūṣakāla utthāya naiṛtīṃ diśamāvrajet| ācchādya dharaṇīṃ pūrvaṃ tṛṇakāṣṭhadalairapi|| 4||
urvarāṃ varjayettiṣṭhannutsarpannnaca buddhimān| tyaktvā mūtrapurīṣe tu yathoktaṃ śaucamācaret|| 5||
dantajivhāviśuddhiñca kṛtvā snātuṃ tato vrajet| nadīṃ taḍāgaṃ vāpīṃ vā saraḥ kūpamathāpi vā|| 6||
kṛtvā pūrvaṃ malasnānaṃ mantrasnānaṃ tataścaret| mṛdā vā candanenāpi tilakaṃ kuṅkumena vā|| 7||
kuryāddhaute vāsasī vā paridhāya śubhānane| upaviśaikacittastu sarvaṃ nityaṃ samāpya ca|| 8||
mṛttikāṃ sundarāṃ snigdhāṃ kṣudrapāṣāṇavarjitām| suviśuddhāmavalmīkāṃ jalasiktāṃ vimardayet|| 9||
kṛtvā cārutarāṃ mūrtiṃ gaṇeśasya śubhāṃ svayam| sarvāvayavasampūrṇāṃ caturbhujavirājitām|| 10||
paraśvādisvāyudhāni dadhatīṃ sundarāṃ ghanām| sthāpya pīṭhe tataḥ pāṇī prakṣālya melayet sudhīḥ|| 11||
pūjādravyāṇi sarvāṇi jalādīni prayatnataḥ| aṣṭagandhānakṣatāṃśca raktapuṣpāṇi guggulam|| 12||
tripañcasaptabhiḥ patrairyutān durvāṅkurān śubhān| aṣṭottaraśataṃ nīlān śvetānānīya sundarān|| 13||
ghṛtadīpaṃ tailadīpaṃ naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ śubham| modakāpūpalaḍḍūkān pāyasaṃ śarkarāyutam|| 14||
sūkṣmaṃ ca tandulānnaṃ ca vyañjanāni bahuni ca| sacandrapūgacūrṇāḍhyaṃ khādyakhādirasaṃyutam|| 15||
elālavaṅgasammiśraṃ tāmbūlaṃ kesarānvitam| jambvāmrapanasādīni drākṣārambhāphalāni ca|| 16||
tattadṛtubhavānīśe nālikerāṇi cānayet| (nārikelāni) bahuprakāramārtikyaṃ kāñcanī dakṣiṇāṃ tathā|| 17||
evaṃ sambhṛtasambhāra ekāntasthalamāsthitaḥ| cailājine kuśamaye āsane ca kṛtāsanaḥ|| 18||
bhūtaśuddhi prakurvīta prāṇānāṃ sthāpanaṃ tathā| digbandhapūrvaṃ devāṃśca gaṇeśādīn nametpurā|| 19||
antarbahirmātṛkāśca nyasedāgamamārgataḥ| sannidhānādikā mudrā darśayedgurūmārgataḥ| mantranyāsaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā ṣaḍaṅganyāsameva ca|| 20||
pūjādravyāṇi saṃśodhya tato dhyāyed gajānanam| ekadantaṃ śūrpakarṇaṃ gajavaktraṃ caturbhujam|| 21||
pāśāṅkuśa dharaṃ devaṃ modakān bibhrataṃ karaiḥ| raktapuṣpamayīṃ mālāṃ kaṇṭhe haste parāṃ śubhām|| 22||
bhaktānāṃ varadaṃ siddhibuddhibhyāṃ sevitaṃ sadā| siddhibuddhipradaṃ nṝṇāṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣadam| brahmarudraharīndrādyaiḥ saṃstutaṃ paramarṣibhiḥ|| 23||
āgaccha jagadādhāra surāsuravarārcitā| anāthanātha sarvajña gīrvāṇaparipūjita|| 24||
svarṇasiṃhāsanaṃ divyaṃ nānāratnasamanvitam| samarpitaṃ mayādeva tatra tvaṃ samupāviśa|| 25||
devadeveśa sarveśa sarvatīrthāhṛtaṃ jalam| pādyaṃ gṛhāṇa gaṇapa gandhapuṣpākṣatairyutam|| 26||
pravālamuktāphalapugaratna tāmbūlajāmbūnadamaṣṭagandham| puṣpākṣatāyuktamamoghaśakte dattaṃ mayārghyaṃ saphalīkuruṣva|| 27||
gaṅgādisarvatīrthebhyaḥ prārthitaṃ toyamuttamam| karpūrailālavaṅgādivāsitaṃ svīkuru prabho|| 28||
campakāśokabakulamālatīmogarādibhiḥ| vāsitaṃ snigdhatāhetu tailaṃ cāru pragṛhayatām|| 29||
kāmadhenu samudbhūtaṃ sarveṣāṃ jīvanaṃ param| pāvanaṃ yajñahetuste payaḥ snānārthamarpitam|| 30||
dhenudugdhasamudbhūtaṃ śuddhaṃ sarvajanaḥ priyam| mayā''nītaṃ dadhivaraṃ snānārthaṃ pratigṛhyatām|| 31||
navanītasamutpannaṃ sarvasantoṣakāraṇam| yajñāṅgaṃ devatāhāro ghṛtaṃ snātuṃ samarpitam|| 32||
puṣpasāraghasambhūtaṃ sarvatejovivardhanam| sarvapuṣṭikaraṃ deva madhusnānārthamarpitam|| 33||
ikṣusārasamudbhūtāṃ śarkarāṃ sumanoharām| malāpahāriṇī snātuṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ mayā'rpitām|| 34||
sarvamādhuryasad_hetuḥ svāduḥ sarva priyaṅkaraḥ| puṣṭikṛt snātumānīta ikṣusārabhavo guḍaḥ 35||
kāṃsye kāṃsyena pihito dadhi madhvājyapūritaḥ| madhuparko mayā''nītaḥ pūjārthaṃ pratigṛhyatām|| 36||
sarvatīrthāhṛtaṃ toyaṃ mayā prārthanayā vibho| suvāsitaṃ gṛhāṇedaṃ samyak snātuṃ sureśvara|| 37||
raktavastrayugaṃ deva lokalajjānivāraṇam| anarghyamatisūkṣmaṃ ca gṛhāṇedaṃ mayārpitam|| 38||
rājataṃ brahmasūtraṃ ca kāñcanaṃ ratnasaṃyutam| bhaktyopapāditaṃ deva gṛhāṇa parameśvara|| 39||
anekaratnayuktāni bhūṣaṇāni bahūni ca| tattadaṅge kāñcanāni yojayāmi tavājñayā|| 40||
aṣṭagandhasamāyuktaṃ raktacandanamuttamam| dvādaśāṅgeṣu te deva lepayāmi kṛpāṃ kurū|| 41||
raktacandanasammiśrāstaṇḍulāstilakopari| śobhāyai sampradāsyāmi gṛhāṇa jagadīśvara|| 42||
pāṭalaṃ karṇikāraṃ ca bandhūkaṃ raktapaṅkajam| mogaraṃ mālatīpuṣpaṃ gṛhyatāṃ parameśvara|| 43||
nānāpaṅkajapuṣpaiśca grathitāṃ pallavairapi| bilvapatrayutāṃ mālāṃ gṛhāṇa sumanoharam|| 44||
daśāṅgaṃ guggulaṃ dhūpaṃ sarvasaugandhyakārakam| sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ tvaṃ gṛhāṇa mayā'rpitam|| 45||
sarvajña sarvalokeṣu tamonāśanamuttamam| gṛhāṇa maṅgalaṃ dīpaṃ devadeva namo'stu te|| 46||
nānāpakvānnasaṃyuktaṃ pāyasaṃ śarkarānvitam| nānāvyañjana śobhāḍhyaṃ śālyodanamanuttamam|| 47||
dadhidugdhaghṛtairyuktaṃ lavaṅgailāsamanvitam| marīcicūrṇasahitaṃ kvathikāvaṭakānvitam|| 48||
rājikādhānyasaṃyuktaṃ methīpiṣṭaṃ satakrakam| hiṅgujīrakakūṣmāṇḍamarīcimāṣapiṣṭakaiḥ|| 49||
sampāditaiḥ supakvaiśca bharjitairvaṭakairyutam| modakāpūpalaḍḍūkaśaṣkulīmaṇḍakādibhiḥ|| 50||
parpaṭairapi saṃyuktaṃ naivedyamamṛtānvit| haridrāhiṅgulavaṇasahitaṃ sūpamuttamam|| 51||
sasāmudraṃ gṛhāṇedaṃ bhojanaṃ kuru sādaram| sutṛptikārakaṃ toyaṃ sugandhaṃ ca pibecchayā|| 52||
tvayi tṛpte jagattṛptaṃ nityatṛpte mahātmani| uttarāpośanārarthaṃ te dadmi toyaṃ suvāsitam|| 53||
mukhapāṇiviśuddhyarthaṃ punastoyaṃ dadāmi te| dāḍimaṃ madhuraṃ nimbujambvāmrapanasādikam|| 54||
drākṣā rambhāphalaṃ pakvakarkandhūkhārjuraṃ phalam| nārikelaṃ ca nāraṅgamāñjiraṃ jambiraṃ tathā|| 55||
urvārukaṃ ca deveśa phalānyetāni gṛhyatām| mukhapāṇi viśuddhayarthaṃ punastoyaṃ dadāmi te|| 56||
gṛhāṇa candanaṃ cāru karāṅgodvartanaṃ śubham| nānāparimaladravyairnirmitaṃ cūrṇamuttamam|| 57||
sugandhināmakaṃ puṇyagandhi cāru pragṛhyatām| cāruśālūrasambhūtaṃ vaṃśasārasamudbhavam|| 58||
sīmantabhūṣaṇaṃ cūrṇaṃ lākṣārañjitamastu te| sacandrapūgacūrṇāḍhyaṃ khādyakhādira saṃyutam|| 59||
elālavaṅgasammiśraṃ tāmbūlaṃ kesarānvitam| nyūnātiriktapūjāyāḥ sampūrṇaphalahetave|| 60||
dakṣiṇāṃ kāñcanīṃ deva sthāpayāmi tavāgrataḥ| sitapītaistathāraktairjalajaiḥ kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ|| 61||
grathitāṃ sundarāṃ mālāṃ gṛhāṇa parameśvara| haritāḥ śvetavarṇā vā pañcatripatrasaṃyutāḥ|| 62||
dūrvāṅkurā mayā dattā ekaviṃśatisammitāḥ| ekaviṃśati saṅkhyākāḥ kurve devapradakṣiṇāḥ|| 63||
pade pade te deveśa naśyantu pātakāni me| audumbare rājate vā kāṃsye kāñcanasambhave|| 64||
pātre prakalpitān dīpān gṛhāṇa cakṣurarpakān| pañcārārti pañcadīpairdīpitāṃ parameśvara|| 65||
cārucandranibhaṃ dīpaṃ gṛhāṇa vīcivāraṇam| yathā'sya nekṣyate bhasma tathā pāpaṃ vināśaya|| 66||
stotrairnānāvidhaiḥ sūktaiḥ sahasranāmabhistataḥ| upaviśya stuvītainaṃ kṛtvā sthirataraṃ manaḥ|| 67||
dīnādhīśa dayānidhe suragaṇaiḥ saṃsevyamāna dvija brahmeśānamahendraśeṣagirijāgandharvasiddhaiḥ stuta| sarvāriṣṭanivāraṇaikanipuṇaḥ trailokyānāthaṃ prabho bhaktiṃ me saphalāṃ kuruṣva sakalāṃ kṣāntvā'parādhānmama|| 68||
iti mūrti samabhyarcya daṇḍavatpraṇipatya ca| japenmantraṃ tato devi sarvasiddhi pradāyakam|| 69||
iti śrīgaṇeśapurāṇe upāsanākhaṇḍe gaṇeśapārthivapūjānirūpaṇaṃ nāmaikonapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 49||
āditaḥ ślokānāṃ samaṣṭyaṅkāḥ 2062 + 69 = 2131
1.50 himavadgirijā saṃvāde caturthīvrata kathanaṃ nāma pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
pārvatyuvāca| ahaṃ mantre na jānāmi girīndra me vada svayam| anugrahaṃ gaṇeśasya yāmi yāmi śivaṃ śivam|| 1||
himāvānuvāca| mantrā nānāvidhā devi nānāsiddhi pradāyakāḥ| asaṅkhyātā gaṇeśasya kāṃścitteṣu vadāmi te|| 2||
kṛtvā padmāsanaṃ samyak niyamya khāni sarvaśaḥ| kṛta nyāsavidhiḥ paścājjapaṃ kuryānijecchayā|| 3||
ekākṣarasya mantrasya lakṣaṃ lakṣārdhameva ca| ṣaḍakṣarasya mantrasya niyutaṃ cāyutaṃ tathā|| 4||
tathā pañcākṣarasyāpi daśāṣṭākṣarayorapi| aṣṭāviṃśadvarṇamantro japtavyo'yutasaṅkhyayā|| 5||
evaṃ nānāvidhānmantrān japanti sveṣṭasiddhaye| tvaṃ tu pārvati me vākyaṃ śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasā|| 6||
ekākṣaraṃ ṣaḍarṇañca gṛhāṇa mantramuttamam| nabhaḥ śukla caturthyāṃ tvamārambhaṃ kuru suvrate|| 7||
anuṣṭhānaṃ māsamānaṃ kuru kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati| śivaṃ prāpsyasi suvyaktamanyadyaccāpi vāñchitam|| 8||
pārthivī pūjitā mūrtiḥ striyā vā puruṣeṇa vā| ekā dadāti sā kāmyaṃ dhanaputrapaśūnapi|| 9||
asādhyaṃ sādhayenmartyo mūrtidvayaprapūjanāt| trimūrtipūjanādrājyaṃ ratnāni sarvasampadaḥ|| 10||
catumūrteḥ pūjayedyo dharmārthakāmamokṣabhāk| sārvabhaumo bhavedrājā pañcamūrtiprapūjanāt|| 11||
ṣaṇmūrtipūjayā sṛṣṭisthitipralayakṛdbhavet| saptāṣṭanavamūrtināṃ pūjayā sarvavid bhavet|| 12||
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca vetti devaprasādataḥ| trayastriṃśatkoṭidevā vahnīndraśivaviṣṇavaḥ|| 13||
sanakādyā munigaṇāḥ sevante daśapūjanāt| ekādaśārcanādeva daśarudrādhipo bhavet|| 14||
dvādaśāditya rājyaṃ ca labhecca dvādaśārcanāt| atisaṅkaṭavelāsu kuryād vṛddhyā prapūjanam|| 15||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ yāvattāvat tattadavāpnuyāt| mahāmuktimavāpnoti lakṣapūjanato'nvaham|| 16||
kārāgṛhānmuktikāmaḥ kārayenmūrtipañcakam| triḥsaptarātrānmucyeta gaṇeśānugrahānmune|| 17||
saptamūrtiḥ prakurarvīta pratyahaṃ pañcavatsaram| mahāpāpāt pramucyeta gaṇeśe bhaktimānnaraḥ|| 18||
ājanmamaraṇādekāṃ pūjayet pārthivīṃ naraḥ| gaṇeśaḥ sa tuvijñeyo darśanād vighnanāśanaḥ|| 19||
tameva sarvakāmeṣa pūjayenna gaṇādhipam| tasyaiva pūjayā prīto na devaḥ syāttathā svayam|| 20||
sarvaroga prapīḍāsu mūrtīnāṃ trayamuttamam| navāhaṃ pūjayedyastu sarvapīḍāṃ vyapohati|| 21||
sauvarṇī rājatī tāmrīrītikāṃsya samudbhavā| mauktikī ca pravālī ca sarvametat prayacchati|| 22||
evaṃ kṛte vrate devi sarvāna kāmānavāpsyasi| yāvad bhādrapade māsi caturthī parilabhyate|| 23||
tasyāṃ mahotsavaḥ kāryo yathā vibhavamādarāt| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ tatkathāvādyagāyanaiḥ|| 24||
prabhāte vimale snātvā pūrvavat pūjayed vibhum| gaṇeśaṃ varadaṃ devaṃ tato homaṃ samārabhet|| 25||
kuṇḍe sāṅge sthaṇḍile vā hūyājjapadaśāṃśataḥ| pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ kuryād balidānapuraḥsaram|| 26||
ācāryaṃ pūjayet paścāt gobhūvāsodhanādibhiḥ| brāhmaṇāṃ stoṣayet paścāddhomaśeṣaṃ samāpayet|| 27||
tarpayettaddaśāṃśena taddaśāṃśena bhojayet| brāhmaṇān vedaviduṣaḥ sapatnīkāṃśca kāṃścana|| 28||
tebhyo bhūṣaṇavāsāṃsi dadyācchaktyā ca dakṣiṇām| dadyāt strīṇāmalaṅkārān yoṣidbhyaśca sakañcukān|| 29||
tuṣṭaye gaṇanāthasya siddhibuddhiyutasya ha| vittaśāṭhayaṃ na kurvīta yathāvibhavamācaret|| 30||
tataḥ suhṛjjanayutaḥ svayaṃ bhuñjīta sādaram| aparasmindine mūrtiṃ nṛyāne sthāpayenmudā|| 31||
chatradhvajapatākābhiścāmarairūpaśobhitām| kiśorairdaṇḍayuddhena yudhyaddhiśca puraḥsaram|| 32||
mahājalāśayaṃ gatvā visṛjya ninayejjale| vādyagītadhvaniyuto nijamandiramāvrajet|| 33||
iti śrīgaṇeśapurāṇe upāsanākhaṇḍe himavadgirijāsaṃvāde caturthīvratakathanaṃ nāma pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 50||
āditaḥ ślokānāṃ samaṣṭyaṅkāḥ 2131+33 = 2164
1.51 himavat pārvatī saṃvādo nāmaka pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
pārvatyuvāca| tava vākyāmṛtenā'haṃ pitaḥ prītā'smi sāmpratam| parantu saṃśayo me'sti taṃ nudasva himālaya|| 1||
kena kena kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ vratametan mahīdharaḥ| ākhyātaṃ kena vā kasmai kaḥ kāṃ siddhimito'gamat|| 2||
etatsavistaraṃ brūhi saṃśayacchedanāya me| yaśca pṛcchati yo vakti gajānanakathā śubhāḥ|| 3||
śṛṇotyanyo'pi yo martyastrayaste puṇyabhāginaḥ| jīvitaṃ saphalaṃ teṣāṃ janma jñānaṃ ca karma ca|| 4||
brahmovāca| evaṃ tayā kṛta praśno himavānabhyabhāṣata| varadasya gaṇeśasya nānājanakṛtaṃ vratam|| 5||
himavānuvāca| śṛṇu pārvati vakṣyāmi saṃvādaṃ te purātanam| setihāsaṃ vratasyāsya sarvasiddhikarasya ha|| 6||
kailāse girivarye tu sukhāsīnaṃ jagadguruma| krīḍamānaṃ mudā devairgandharvaiḥ paramarṣibhiḥ|| 7||
natvā stutvā mahātejāḥ paripapraccha ṣaṇmukhaḥ|| 8||
skanda uvāca| devadeva jagannātha bhaktānāmabhayaṅkara| nānākhyānāni divyāni śrutāni tvatprasādataḥ|| 9||
tṛptiṃ tāta na gacchāmi pāyaṃ pāyaṃ sudhāmiva| adhunā brūhi me deva vrataṃ sarvārthasiddhidam|| 10||
anuṣṭhānena yasyātha karasthā siddhayo nṛṇām| jāyante sādhakānāṃ tu varadasya prasādataḥ|| 11||
śiva uvāca| sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā skanda sarveṣāṃ hitakārakam| kathayāmi tava prītyā mahāsiddhipradaṃ bhuvi|| 12||
vināyakapriyaṃ tāta vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam| sarveṣāṃ puruṣārthānāṃ sādhakaṃ kṛttikātmaja|| 13||
vināyajñaistathā dānairjapahomādibhirvinā| sarvasiddhikaraṃ skanda putrapautrapravardhanam|| 14||
rājānaṃ rājaputraṃ vā tanmantriṇamathā'pi vā| vaśamānayati kṣipraṃ vratametanma'hattamam|| 15||
mahāpāpopapāpaiśca bahujanmasu sañcitaiḥ| vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa taiḥ pumān mucyate kṣaṇāt|| 16||
bhājanaṃ sarvasiddhīnāṃ jāyate mānavo bhuvi| prītidaṃ tu gaṇeśasya nānena sadṛśaṃ kṣitau|| 17||
skanda uvāca| tāta kasmin bhavenmāsi vratametanmahottamam| vidhānaṃ kīdṛśaṃ cāsya kena vā''caritaṃ purā|| 18||
sarvametanmamācakṣva yadyasti karuṇā mayi|
śiva uvāca| nabhaḥ śukla caturthyāntu snātvā gurugṛhaṃ vrajet| praṇamya taṃ guruṃ paścātpūjayitvā yathāvidhi|| 19||
pādyācamanavastrādyairbhūṣaṇaśca mahattaraiḥ| toṣayitvā tu taṃ samyagājñayā prārabhed vratam|| 20||
sarvasiddhikaraṃ tāta vrataṃ gāṇeśvaraṃ guro| tvameva śrīgaṇeśo'si diśakāmapradaṃ prabho|| 21||
upadiṣṭe vrate tena sārdhaṃ gaṅgātaṭaṃ vrajet| taḍāgaṃ vā devakhātaṃ tatra snāyād yathāvidhi|| 22||
śvetasarṣapayuktena tilakalkena ṣaṇmukha| snātvā dhātrīyuteneha kṛtvā nityaṃ gṛhaṃ vrajet|| 23||
upaviśyāsane śuddhe pūjayitvā gaṇādhipam| gurupadiṣṭamārgeṇa vrataṃ paścāt samārabhet|| 24||
mṛdā mūrtiṃ gaṇeśasya caturthyāṃ śrāvaṇasya tu| pratyahaṃ pūjayetkṛvā yāvadbhādracaturthikā|| 25||
brahmacaryavrate sthitvā kartavyaṃ vratamuttamam| upavāsaika bhaktābhyāṃ naktenāyācitena vā|| 26||
caturthakāle bhuñjīta haviṣyānnaṃ samāhitaḥ| akṣaraṃ madhuraṃ bhuñjan bhaktimānācaredvratam|| 27||
japan gāṇeśvarīṃ vidyāṃ ṣaḍānana ṣaḍakṣarīm| dvicaturakṣarāṃ vāpi tathaivaikākṣarāmapi|| 28||
daśākṣarāmatha skanda dvādaśārṇāmathāpi vā| niyutaṃ vā'yutaṃ vāpi pratyahaṃ japa iṣyate|| 29||
tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā daśāṃśaṃ homamācaret| dhyāyan gajānanaṃ deva mahorātramatandritaḥ|| 30||
prāpte proṣṭhapade māsi caturthyāṃ tu gajānanam| sauvarṇapalamānena tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ|| 31||
mayūravāhanaṃ kuryādathavā''khugataṃ śubham| kṛtvā maṇḍapikāṃ tatra dhānyarāśiṃ prakalpayet|| 32||
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ kalaśaṃ sthāpayet tataḥ| tasyopari nyasetpātraṃ rukmarājatatāmrakam|| 33||
vastrayugmena saṃveṣṭya sapātraṃ kalaśaṃ tataḥ| pañcapallava saṃyuktaṃ pañcaratnasamanvitam|| 34||
pīṭhapūjāṃ purā kṛtvā sthāpayettatra taṃ vibhum| mūlamantraiśca vedoktaiḥ pūrvoktairapi ṣaṇmukha|| 35||
dhyātvā gajānanaṃ devamāvāhya parayā mudā| āsanaṃ ca tathā pādyaṃ dadyādācamanīyakam|| 36||
arghyaṃ ratnayutaṃ skanda snānaṃ pañcāmṛtaiḥ śubham| suvāsitābhiradbhiśca snāpayet parameśvaram| raktavastrayugaṃ dadyādupavītaṃ tathottamam|| 37||
nānāvidhairābharaṇairbhūṣayet parameśvaram| gandhākṣatairdhūpadīpairnaivedyervividhairapi|| 38||
vaṭakāpūpalaḍḍūkaśālyannapāyasādibhiḥ| pañcāmṛtairvyañjanaiśca bhojayet parameśvaram|| 39||
udvartana kare dadyāt phalaṃ tāmbūlameva ca| kāñcanīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyācchatraṃ vyañjanacāmare|| 40||
nīrājanaṃ mantrapuṣpaṃ datvā stotrāṇyudīrayet| sahasranāmabhiḥ stutvā brāhmaṇān pūjayettataḥ|| 41||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā gītanṛtyādi maṅgalaiḥ| prabhāte vimale snātvā nityaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi|| 42||
pūjayetpūrvavaddevaṃ tato homaṃ samācaret| dravairnānāvidhairhutvā kuryādācāryapūjanam|| 43||
gobhūtilahiraṇyādyaṃ gurave tannivedayet| anyebhyo brāhmaṇebhyaśca pradadyād bhūri dakṣiṇām|| 44||
brāhmaṇān bhojayet paścācchatamaṣṭottaraṃ tathā| adhikān yadi śaktiścedathavā'pyekaviṃśatim|| 45||
dīnāndhakṛpaṇebhyaśca dadyādannaṃ sapāyasam| punaśca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt pragṛhyāśiṣamuttamām|| 46||
suhṛdbandhuyuto maunī svayaṃ bhuñjīta sādaram|| 47||
śiva uvāca| evaṃ te kathitaṃ skanda varadasya vrataṃ śubham| bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam|| 48||
purātanamitihāsāsminnarthe vadāmi te| mahādharmaparo rājā purā'bhūt kardamābhidhaḥ|| 49||
pālayāmāsa vasudhāṃ sāgarāntāṃ svatejasā| guṇairyasya hṛtā devā nityaṃ yatsadasi sthitāḥ|| 50||
kadācid daivayogena bhṛgustasya gṛhaṃ yayau| tata utthāya rājā sa bahumāna puraḥsaram|| 51||
upaviśyāsane śreṣṭhe pūjito guruvat tataḥ| bhuktvā sthitaṃ munivaraṃ rājā vacanamabravīt|| 52||
rājovāca| bhagavan sarvatattvajña kiñcit pṛcchāmi tad vada| pūrvajanmani kaścāhaṃ kiṃ mayā sukṛtaṃ kṛtam|| 53||
yenedṛśaṃ mayā rājyaṃ prāptaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam| prāptaṃ naiva nṛpairanyairna ca prāpsyanti cāpare|| 54||
devānāmapi pūjyo'haṃ gandharvoragarākṣasām| kuberasampadā tulyāṃ sampadaṃ paśyame mune|| 55||
